parameters.range: None – Assisted – Remote Automated Valet
parameters.description: 车辆自动完成进入/退出车位的能力，包含传感器、控制逻辑与执行器的集成。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在设计参数上优先支持远程泊车、传感器套件、可靠HMI（例如带显示屏的钥匙）和车辆控制器以实现自动入/出库功能。

parameters.range: examples span ~5–50 kWh (early/varies by vehicle type); typical small/urban packs ~8–21.6 kWh; future systems scalable to 100+ kWh
parameters.description: 车载电池总能量，决定纯电续航与混合动力辅助能力，同时影响包装、重量与设计可行性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize energy storage capacity, electric powertrain packaging and drivetrain efficiency as primary design parameters.

parameters.range: 见上
parameters.description: 见上

guidance.howToGuide: 要求CV点在空间与投影视图上均匀、有序排列，并限制曲线交叠与反向趋势。

parameters.range: Typical 0.25–0.40 depending on vehicle segment; small vehicles typically 0.25–0.35; design targets can be ≤0.24 for highly optimized models.
parameters.description: 整车平均风阻系数（Cd），用于衡量空气阻力并影响续航/燃油效率。作为设计参数时常以目标Cd表述，用于可持续性与续航表现评估；典型值随细分市场不同，小型车常见0.25–0.35，部分优化目标可达到≤0.24。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 以低风阻为目标，通过简洁曲面与减少外露细节实现更低Cd

parameters.range: from large electromechanical relays to microscopic MST sensors
parameters.description: Physical envelope of electronic modules and sensors; smaller sizes enable different packaging and aesthetic outcomes.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Drive design parameter targets toward reduced physical footprint and higher integration (use MST, IC integration and higher-density packaging).

parameters.range: Scalable from microcontroller to multi-core domain controllers; application dependent, Low - Very High
parameters.description: Computational capability required to run advanced algorithms, sensor fusion and control logic, combined with processing capacity per unit mass that affects packaging and architecture. This parameter covers absolute processing performance and performance density considerations for system-level integration.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize higher processing capability and active miniaturization (MST) as target design parameters to deliver complex features in small form factors.

parameters.range: 基础智能-高级自动驾驶辅助

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 强调中控大屏、人机交互、OTA能力与高级驾驶辅助系统配置。

parameters.range: small->large (e.g. 7-20 inch diagonal)
parameters.description: 仪表/中控显示的可视面积，影响视觉冲击力与信息承载能力。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先采用大面积可视面板与窄边框设计，以传达现代与技术感。

parameters.range: fixed/static → single-mode..multi-mode → fully_reconfigurable/fully_dynamic
parameters.description: Degree to which the vehicle display/interface layout and information content can be reconfigured by software or user preferences (e.g., modes, profiles), enabling switching for different markets, vehicle lines or driving contexts. / 显示与仪表界面的可软件重构能力，便于按市场/车系/驾驶情境切换显示内容。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize software‑defined, user‑customizable interface parameters: dynamic layouts, context modes, user profiles and service integration.

parameters.range: typ. 0.20–0.35 (modern passenger cars); reported overall 0.20–0.45 depending on vehicle type; sport/roadster and some historical/early designs up to ~0.55; rare outliers reported to ~0.6
parameters.description: Non-dimensional coefficient describing aerodynamic resistance produced by a vehicle's shape. It is a primary geometric parameter affecting aerodynamic drag, fuel/energy consumption, range and top speed. Influenced by silhouette, roofline, tail tapering, surface transitions and added aerodynamic devices.

guidance.howToGuide: Set low target coefficient of drag (Cd) as a primary design objective; motivate shapes and surface treatments to reduce drag.

parameters.range: 100 Mbps - 100 Gbps+
parameters.description: Aggregate communication capacity required across vehicle networks and sensors.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify design parameters that prioritize electrical bandwidth, compute power density and reduced mechanical packaging to express technological capability.

parameters.range: level: low|medium|high; strategy: architectural|modular|monolithic
parameters.description: Degree and strategy of integration between mechanical subsystems and electrical/electronic architecture, including how electrical systems determine packaging, module integration and visible styling cues. Captures both the intensity (low–high) and the architectural approach (architectural|modular|monolithic).

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize design parameters that enable electrical packaging and visibility — e.g., battery/EV module packaging, modular electrical bays, simplified HVAC/drive-train cowling, and exterior cues that suggest electrification.

parameters.parameter: Ergonomics; ControlErgonomics; ControlsAndDisplaysErgonomics; Ergonomics Requirements; Ergonomic Parameters; Weighted Ergonomic Score
parameters.range: seat height/width/depth per anthropometric standards; reach envelope; control force and adjustment ranges; controls & displays compliance 0-1; weighted ergonomic score 0-100; qualitative optimization levels (low/medium/high)
parameters.description: 综合人体工学设计参数，涵盖座椅几何（高度/宽度/深度/H-point）、可达包络(reach envelope)、控制件力/操作行程、控制与显示的可视性与标识、以及各项可调节范围与设计容差。包含定量合规性评分（控制与显示的可用性可用0-1评分表示）以及总体加权人体工学得分（0-100分）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在人体工程学上预留可调节与可扩展空间以适应未来人口结构、使用习惯与技术界面变化（如触控/语音/远程交互）。

parameters.parameter: Frontal area & Roofline curvature / 正面投影面积与车顶曲率
parameters.range: 正面投影面积：随车型级别变化（按气动目标微调）；车顶曲率：从后部急降（steep rear drop）到平滑连续弧线（smooth continuous arc），可描述为 low–medium–high curvature；车顶坡度：按气动目标与包装需求调节，通常由仿真与试验确定。
parameters.unit: 正面投影面积: m^2；车顶曲率: degrees 或 curvature radius (m)；车顶坡度/高差表征: mm/m 或 %；亦可采用定性描述 (qualitative)
parameters.description: 组合的几何参数：正面投影面积决定空气动力学阻力的基准值（Cd·A），车顶弧度与坡度影响气流贴附与尾部分离，从而影响压力恢复与整车Cd值。两者需协同优化，在造型、内部空间与法规约束之间权衡，并通过CFD与风洞试验验证。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Priorizar líneas continuas, techo envolvente y reducción del área frontal para transmitir futurismo y modernidad.

parameters.parameter: HMI Responsiveness / HMI latency (HMI 响应性/延迟)
parameters.range: 目标: ≤100 ms；实现/子系统范围: 5–200 ms（例如显示/触控子系统常见目标5–50 ms）
parameters.description: 目标响应性用于衡量用户输入（触控、语音、触觉）到系统反馈的延迟。界面与语音/触控响应延迟直接影响“懂你”的体验感知、智能流畅度、质量感与安全性。包含对显示、触控及控制反馈的延时与反馈时序要求。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize low-latency HMI, predictable feedback loops, and configurability thresholds that maximize user comfort and task efficiency.

parameters.parameter: 中控/仪表显示尺寸与布局
parameters.description: 显示器尺寸与集成度影响科技感与交互体验

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 采用大面板一体化、中控虚拟化及流线型界面设计传达科技感

parameters.range: 12.0 V to 12.8 V (regulated test supply typical)

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Calls for regulated supply/voltage specification (e.g., 12.0–12.8 V) to ensure consistent lamp output for safety-critical illumination.

parameters.description: Diagonal size of the primary central/infotainment display; affects information presentation, touch interaction, layout, ergonomics and perceived technology level. Common passenger-vehicle screens typically fall in the ~7–15 inch range, some small displays can be ~4", and integrated/home-theater style systems can reach up to ~50".

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize larger screen diagonals, centralized display placement and reallocated dashboard real estate to support entertainment hardware.

parameters.range: early-middle-late

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): Adopt a staged integration strategy: prototype → refinement → scalable production once reliability and cost targets met.

parameters.range: family-consistent proportions and geometry; 品牌家族化线条与外廓必须保持，可能限制最大/最小尺寸
parameters.unit: mm / 轮廓规范 / 描述性
parameters.description: 灯组的尺寸与外廓（size/outline），强调家族化比例与几何的一致性，可能对最大/最小尺寸有约束。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 限定灯组几何参数（薄、长、端点几何形状）与前脸简洁曲面，确保识别性与现代感。

parameters.parameter: LuminousIntensityAtTestPoints / PhotometryTestPoint_Intensity (光学测试点发光强度)
parameters.range: 随灯具功能与测试点而异；示例值： (0°,0°): 40,000–70,000 cd（头灯中心线, 远射强度）；(-3°,1°) & (3°,1°): ≥5,000 cd（侧向头灯测试点）；信号灯（转向/制动等）典型约 100–1,500 cd；某些法规/测试点最小值可低至 0.25 cd。具体点的最小/最大值以对应的测试表为准。
parameters.description: 车辆光学光度学中在指定测试点测得的发光强度，用于表征远近投射、横向分布及信号灯可见性。数值高度依赖灯具类型、功能及法规要求，应按相应测试表或车辆认证要求判定具体数值。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Define candela minima/maxima at angular test points and test protocols (voltage, distance, goniometer aiming) per regulatory photometric requirements to ensure visibility and safety.

parameters.range: 0.1-5 mm （适用于几何精度）
parameters.description: 综合的数字模型精度指标：包括（1）经校准后有限元（FEM）对静载荷和固有频率等预测的误差精度（以百分比误差表示）；（2）数字模型的几何精度，影响表面质量、装配间隙与快速成型可行性（以毫米表示）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 推动更高的建模精度、可参数化的造型控制和直接面向制造的数据输出

parameters.range: radical ↔ incremental
parameters.description: Controllable variables that determine major packaging, wheelbase, cabin placement and overall silhouette.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize architecture-level changes (new packaging, proportions) first, then cascade innovations into surface and detailing parameters.

parameters.range: 6（固定于概念设计中）

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在仪表板、侧墙和后墙集成多块高清显示屏以覆盖全舱交互需求，支持多用户同时使用。
建议采用多层叠置的OLED单元、在三维中构成L形或层状阵列，并通过时间序列点亮实现深度感与方向感。

parameters.range: 0-100 (表示可定制程度百分比)；Preset profiles + user-defined packages/combinations；多个包与组合可选，反映配置多样性
parameters.unit: percent / count / presets（视具体子参数而定）
parameters.description: 汇总量化与分类的可定制性参数：既可用百分比量化用户可调节的程度，也包含预设配置与用户自定义配置（profiles & defaults），并体现多个可选包与组合的数量与多样性；同时注明部分项可由默认安全限制锁定以保证安全性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 确保UI/UX可高度配置以匹配个性化需求，支持用户主导的体验构建

parameters.description: 产品开发决策所依据的预测时间窗口；Futuring主张缩短此窗口以提高预测准确性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先采用较短的规划视界（near-term，1-3年），通过迭代快速验证用户需求，减少远期预测不确定性对设计决策的影响。

parameters.range: ICE, Electric, Hydrogen, Hybrid
parameters.description: Choice of propulsion system which fundamentally affects packaging, weight distribution, and user perception.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize electrified powertrains (battery electric, hydrogen, hybrids) in concept and production choices; use visible cues and packaging to express sustainability.

parameters.range: categorical: exposed | flush | hidden; qualitative: low | medium | high
parameters.description: Degree to which sensors (radar, lidar, cameras), actuators and control units are visually exposed or integrated into vehicle bodywork or subsystems (e.g., headlamp system). Covers both visual integration states (exposed, flush, hidden) and overall integration degree (qualitative: low/medium/high).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize minimal visual intrusion of perception hardware, continuous exterior surfaces, and proportions that emphasize interior comfort and sensor performance.

parameters.range: discreet / flush / integrated
parameters.description: 为摄像头、雷达和传感器在格栅、风挡与后视镜位置提供集成空间并兼顾美学与功能性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在外观上为传感器与雷达等装置预留融合位置，同时通过光学与材料细节传达功能可信度与高端感。

parameters.description: 描述车辆造型的锐利程度，包含局部边缘的几何/视觉锐利度（Edge Sharpness）与整体视觉感受的锐利度（Overall Sharpness）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过在车身纵向布置明显的折线与棱线，提高总体视觉锐度与表面分割感，规定腰线与肩线的角度和位置

parameters.range: discrete set; subtle - bold
parameters.description: Distinctive grille, lighting graphics, surface creases or emblem treatments that encode a unique identity. 家族式设计必须包含并控制的标识性参数，如格栅形状、灯光签名、腰线角度等。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Define signature details, new material language and novel lighting to create recognizability.

parameters.parameter: Silhouette Proportion / Silhouette Profile / 轮廓/外形比例与型态
parameters.range: 综合性描述：包括长前机舱/短舱强调（long-hood / short-cabin）、紧凑跑车到加长轿车的外形比例（compact-coupe → elongated-sedan）、短前悬/高腰线/适中车长等家族化特征；可量化示例有高度/长度比 0.45–0.55、或高/宽/长比例示例 1:1.6–1:2.5；视觉上也可描述为紧凑→拉长（compact → elongated）；特定家族廓形如 Berlinette：低矮流线车顶与短悬；轮廓曲线方面从中度到高度连续曲率（影响正投投影面积/frontal area）；型态类别可为 upright–boxy–streamlined–wedge 或 流线型/高屋顶/方正（定性）。
parameters.unit: ratio / qualitative / visual proportion / frontal area (m²)
parameters.description: 定义车辆整体外廓的几何和视觉特性：包括高度、长度、屋顶线、前后悬以及轮廓曲线的连续性。决定第一视觉印象（优雅或运动感）、空气动力学表现与家族化识别（例如 Berlinette 廓形）。既可用定量指标（如高/长比、投影面积）衡量，也常以定性分类描述型态与风格演变（从草图到精化模型的设计流程中均需考虑）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Promover continuidad de superficies y transiciones suaves en la silueta para reducir área frontal y evitar separaciones de flujo.

parameters.range: none - full_modular
parameters.description: 表示车辆支持通过OTA进行功能升级的深度与范围。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先保证软件可升级性、开放性与用户自定义度，硬件形态兼顾模块化与长期可维护性

parameters.description: 控制每个切面之间的夹角与折皱程度，直接影响低多边形外观的锐利程度与反光分布。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 规定面片数量与拐折角度，形成低多边形切面语言并决定整体光影与折线走向，影响表面细分与视觉粗糙度。

parameters.range: TRL1-TRL9

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Introduce conservative constraints and technology-readiness checks into parameters; require expert technical validation before committing to future-facing proposals.
Position and size screens for prominence while maintaining ergonomic sightlines and minimizing distraction.

parameters.description: 车辆语音控制能力：包含是否支持语音激活以减少手部操作，以及通过语音可操作的功能比例。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): Maximize voice-control coverage for common tasks to reduce manual interaction and enable hands-free operation.

parameters.parameter: Windshield Rake Angle / Windscreen Rake Angle (挡风/风挡倾角)
parameters.range: Typical values from vertical: ~10–40° (commonly 10–35°; many sources use 10–45° as an upper practical bound). When reported from horizontal (alternate convention, WA) typical values ≈50–75° (e.g. baseline example 64° from horizontal ≈ 26° from vertical). Broad absolute bounds in datasets can span ~0–90° but practical/packaging limits are much narrower.
parameters.description: Inclination (rake) of the windshield/windscreen relative to vertical (most commonly reported) — a primary packaging and exterior-design parameter that influences aerodynamic drag (Cd), forward visibility and vertical field-of-view, greenhouse proportions, interior headroom, driver sightlines, reflection geometry and veiling glare, and overall vehicle styling.

guidance.howToGuide: Increase windshield rake angle (steeper inclination) to improve flow attachment and present a modern technological image.

parameters.range: low → high (pixels per area; depends on panel density and element spacing)
parameters.unit: pixels/cm² (areal pixel density; sometimes reported as pixels)
parameters.description: Pixel density or visual resolution for vehicle-mounted displays (e.g., rear displays or signaling panels). Determines ability to render legible text, symbols or detailed graphics at intended viewing distances.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提升灯具像素数与分割单元，以支持更复杂的语义信息和动画（例如从24→84→1024+像素的演进）。

parameters.description: 信息刷新/推送频率，用于实时数据与警示的更新速率

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 鼓励更高的更新频率与低延迟展示，但在高负荷驾驶情境中应实施节流与合并策略

parameters.range: 中-高

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先提升智能化配置与续航能力，同时保持流线型车身与较低的车重以兼顾效率与操控。

parameters.range: ornate - simple；高简化/高连续性至传统元素多样化
parameters.description: 外表平整/简洁程度，表示表面简化程度与连续性，用于传达数字化/电子化的视觉感受。可用于衡量从装饰性/复杂（ornate）到高度简化且表面连续（simple/high continuity）的设计取向。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 强调干净的表面、界面化元素、减少可见机械细节，从视觉上向电子化倾斜

parameters.description: 前灯光幕的物理长度与像素（LED）数量，直接影响视觉规模与动态表现能力

guidance.howToGuide: 将前脸灯光作为主要造型语言，拉伸横向视觉尺寸并以像素密度定义可视分辨率

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过电池容量、能量密度、驱动效率与能耗管理的设计来实现期望续航

parameters.range: 0-10（0为无装饰、10为极复杂）
parameters.description: 量化车身表面装饰元素与细节的密度与可见性，用数值索引表示复杂程度，数值越低越趋向极简主义，便于对比设计方案的装饰强度。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将表面装饰复杂度降至最低、采用贯穿或隐形灯组、用几何化轮廓替代细节雕饰以强化未来感。

parameters.range: 低-中-高（示例：10-400 TOPS）
parameters.description: 车载AI计算能力常用度量，影响高级辅助驾驶与智能服务的能力。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 把算力作为产品定位维度，制定高/中/低算力分级，作为竞品对标轴线。

parameters.parameter: 车身曲率/曲面光滑度/曲率圆润度/车身曲线曲率
parameters.range: 可表达为：高（连续平滑曲面）；或分级 low|medium|high；或描述为平滑过渡至明显弧度
parameters.unit: qualitative（定性描述） 或 1/mm（数值曲率）或文字曲率描述
parameters.description: 反映车身外形曲面平滑性与曲率分布，既可做定性圆润度/平滑度评价，也可用曲率值（1/mm）定量描述以体现过渡是否平滑或出现明显弧度。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过强调连续流线与大面积曲面，形成科技感与未来感的整体视觉语言。

recalled_nodes.label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
recalled_nodes.name: Wood-rim steering wheel and leather interior

paths.path: Wood-rim steering wheel and leather interior -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 豪华
paths.reason: 改变的是材料感知与细节层面；木质方向盘与真皮座椅作为可见材料与精细工艺，直接映射到Rubric中的DisplayMaterialSelection、Surface Finish与内饰材质与做工精细度等参数，是豪华定位的稳定信号，能持续强化豪华感知。

paths.path: Wood-rim steering wheel and leather interior -> TypeAssociatedWith -> 中型SUV
paths.reason: 以木质与真皮为主的手工感内饰是偏豪华定位的中型SUV的典型特征，足以将车型指向中型豪华SUV，与图谱该级别的豪华风格一致。

parameters.range: two-seat open / convertible
parameters.description: 车体布局与座位数（例如两座敞篷），直接影响视觉比例与用途。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先采用敞篷两座布局、简约轻质车身与细节装饰以呈现巡游舒适与优雅感。

parameters.parameter: C点位置（相对车长的位置）
parameters.range: 靠前/居中/靠后（以车身纵向百分比或绝对距离表示）
parameters.description: C点位置影响视觉重心与前后尾部力量感的传达。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将C点适度后移以增强尾部份量感，使整车视觉更稳重、沉稳，常用于豪华车。

parameters.range: 1-50 (context-dependent)

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize reduction of part count, clarity of interfaces, and proportional harmony when defining dimensional and assembly parameters.

parameters.description: Curb/vehicle weight (mass of vehicle without occupants or cargo). Source records reference a broad set of values reflecting different vehicles, eras, or measurement/reporting differences. Representative reported examples: ~520 kg (≈500–550 kg), 615 kg, ≈635 kg, 970–1160 kg. One record contains 6000 kg which is likely erroneous.

guidance.howToGuide: Size and weight are acceptable trade-offs to achieve solidity and quietness.

parameters.range: typical: 20–80 kg/m3 (low – medium – high)
parameters.description: 填充材料的体积密度，决定材料的有效刚度、支撑性、耐久性和‘硬度’感受。较高密度通常对应更高的支撑与耐久性。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): Lower effective cushion density and increase compliant foam layers to enhance perceived softness and comfort

parameters.range: Depends on panel/door geometry and packaging: lateral (inboard→outboard; component-level lateral positions), circumferential around an aperture (沿周向/沿车门周边), longitudinal fore/aft offset (front cut line), variable curvature and termination; variable depending on panel geometry
parameters.unit: mm; relative (panel width %); angular position; qualitative (position/curve)
parameters.description: Geometric definition of panel cut lines including location (lateral, circumferential, longitudinal), curvature, termination and alignment to character lines. Defines removable/hinged panel borders and maximum aperture geometry, affects clear aperture, visual seam location, packaging and ingress/egress (e.g. foot swing and seating entry).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify uniform gap widths, align cut lines with body character lines, prioritize continuous visual flow when defining cut-line location and shape.

parameters.description: Very large displacement to provide low-rpm torque and quiet running.

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize large-displacement low-rev engines, stately proportions (long bonnet), heavy robust chassis and surface finishes (polished silver) to convey luxury, silence and endurance.

parameters.range: soft-touch plastics to metal trims
parameters.description: Selection of visible materials and finishes for tactile interfaces and surround trims to signal quality.

guidance.howToGuide: Specify material finishes, seam treatments and consistent joint tolerances to reinforce perceived quality.

parameters.description: Straight-6 layout used historically for smoothness.

guidance.howToGuide: Specify cylinder count and engine packaging that favor smoothness and refinement.

parameters.range: 典型取值宽广，约 50–1000 hp（文献中亦见 0–600 CV）；示例值：113 CV @6500 rpm、345 CV、474 CV、480–550 hp
parameters.description: 发动机输出功率，直接影响加速、最高速与车辆的性能感知。值随车辆类型与时代差异很大，应以具体车型目标为准。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 采用更大排量与更高功率的动力总成以传达机械上的优越感，与外观的宏伟形象相呼应。

parameters.range: subtle to extreme (low mm to several 100s mm above trunkline); often high on classic 1950s designs
parameters.description: Height of tail fin above trunk surface; a visual control for 1950s stylistic drama. 尾鳍的垂直尺寸参数。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将尾鳍垂直高度与后部灯组位置上移、加长车身比例、扩展镀铬覆盖面积，以在视觉上增强庄重与奢华感。

parameters.range: rearward shift ~50–150 mm (relative to conventional layout)
parameters.description: Fore–aft location of the front axle relative to the vehicle front/bumper; controls overhang and effective wheelbase.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Pull the front wheel/axle rearward relative to the bumper to shorten front overhang and extend cabin length within a given overall length.

parameters.description: 车窗面积相对于车身侧面整体的占比，影响视觉重心、运动感、豪华感以及驾驶视野与安全感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 维持中等车窗/车身比例（约40%~50%玻璃），在开放感与金属质感之间取得平衡以提升豪华气质。

parameters.range: 定性：高/中/低；定量：0-10
parameters.description: 综合衡量人机界面的信息层级与交互步骤数量（简洁度）以及显示与控制的整合程度与视觉统一性（集成度）。可依据需要采用定性分级（高/中/低）或量化评分（0-10）分别评估不同维度。

guidance.howToGuide: 优先降低操作复杂度、提升内饰视觉质量与服务化体验

parameters.range: 航空级材料与紧密公差

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过设计目标要求所有关键零件达到高精度与高耐久性，从而推动内部制造与工艺控制。

parameters.description: 从前保险杠到挡风玻璃前缘的轴向长度，决定车辆前部视觉占比与前悬长度。该参数用于表达家族设计语言（如长引擎舱以体现动力与后驱比例）、为纵置发动机或大排量动力总成留出安装空间，并可根据设计目标相对缩短以实现轿跑化比例或放大以容纳纵置发动机（与整车长度成比例增长）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过拉长机舱、提升引擎可见性与加强镀铬细节来确定关键几何参数，如机舱长度与格栅比例。

parameters.parameter: Hood length / deck ratio; proportions (long hood / short deck); Proporciones ejecutivas (long hood / short deck)
parameters.range: Long hood / short rear deck — visually emphasizes an elongated bonnet and compact cabin/rear deck; commonly creates the perception of a forward-mounted (front) engine compressing rear seating space.
parameters.description: A classic GT/executive proportion language: elongated bonnet combined with a compact rear deck that reinforces sporty or luxury family identity through visual emphasis and balance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor long-hood / short-deck proportions, smooth uninterrupted surfacing and balanced overhangs to achieve a refined silhouette.

parameters.range: basic - premium

guidance.howToGuide: Retain leather, high-quality trims and refinement in cabin while allowing exterior to be performance-focused.

parameters.range: steel; aluminum (aluminium); GRP/composite; polymers; ceramics; recycled
parameters.description: Categorical parameter specifying the primary material family used for visible and structural parts; includes conventional and recycled materials (e.g., steel, aluminum/aluminium, GRP/composites, polymers, ceramics).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritise materials (natural veneers, high-grade polymers, metallic paints) that can achieve the target tactile and visual outcomes within manufacturing capabilities.

parameters.parameter: compressibility; hardness; coefficient_of_friction; surface_finish; texture; color; lightness; gloss
parameters.range: 依材料与部位而异，需通过研究确定目标区间
parameters.unit: 各参数单位不同（mm/N, Shore/MPa, 无量纲, Ra μm, CIELAB/L*, gloss GU 等）
parameters.description: 室内构件可测量的客观物理特性集合，当前工具可测但与‘愉悦感/工艺感’的预测力有限。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 指导对室内材料可测量参数（如压缩性、硬度、摩擦系数、表面粗糙度/光泽、纹理、颜色/明度等）进行系统研究与目标化，以将物理量化指标映射到愉悦感与工艺感的目标区间，进而用于材料选择与表面处理规范。

parameters.range: Subjective: Very Low–Moderate; Measured cabin noise targets: ~55–70 dB; Component/tuning effect: variable (depends on material and layout); Frequency: design-targeted bands to avoid resonance
parameters.unit: dB (cabin noise); subjective score; dB/Hz for spectral NVH metrics; Hz for frequency targeting
parameters.description: Overall design parameter for reduction and control of transmitted noise and vibration from drivetrain and vehicle structure. Defines target noise/vibration characteristics (both subjective and measured) that drive choices in insulation, mounting, powertrain calibration, panel placement and material selection. Includes both broadband level targets and frequency-band targeting to avoid resonances.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Set stringent NVH (noise, vibration, harshness) targets and smooth torque curves; favor multi-cylinder or electrically assisted solutions.

parameters.description: Side, front/rear and plan views showing outlines, component layout (battery underfloor, motors at axles), occupant envelope and benchmark overlays.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Orthographic views should emphasize pushed-to-corner wheels, short overhangs, and the tension arc character line; include side, front, rear and plan to communicate packaging and system layout (battery, motor locations).

parameters.range: Reported numeric ranges: 4200–5250 mm (typical targets 4200–5200 mm or 4600–5250 mm); qualitative targets: shorter than contemporary cars, reduced rear overhang to enable compact packaging and garage fit while preserving >=7 seats.
parameters.description: Total vehicle exterior length. A key control for vehicle proportions, classification, urban maneuverability and parking. Design goals emphasize a compact overall length (shorter than contemporaries) achieved via reduced rear overhang and packaging optimization to fit common family garages while maintaining interior capacity (including 7+ seating where required). Constraints include market segment, family design language, cost/weight/performance trade-offs, and impact on axle/overhang relationships.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Set dimensional targets and packaging constraints that prioritize occupant volume and compact exterior length; trade off overhangs vs wheelbase for agile proportions.

parameters.range: Typical examples span ~2000–6000 mm depending on segment. Documented examples: 2800–4200 mm (2.8–4.2 m), ≈3.3–4.2 m, ≈3.7 m, 3000–5000 mm; extreme example: 6400 mm (Bugatti). Microcars trend toward minimized lengths; some designs support variable/extendable overall length up to +1200 mm.
parameters.description: Total exterior (overall) vehicle length. A primary packaging constraint influenced by wheelbase, front/rear overhangs and powertrain packaging. Notes: microcars minimize length to improve urban maneuverability; overall length can be reduced via rear packaging and shortened front overhang; some concepts allow variable/extendable overall length for specific use cases.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 扩大整车长度与前舱体积以彰显气派与豪华感。

parameters.range: referenced per package/regulatory needs; sketch options referenced in sources ~990–1400 mm (context-dependent)
parameters.description: Exterior width of the vehicle; governed by regulations and functional packaging requirements. Influences frontal area and aerodynamic drag.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize broad, flowing surfaces and restrained overall width to convey handcrafted elegance; set target proportions for wheelhouse-to-body ratios.

parameters.range: 0.5 - 3.0 mm (commonly specified; some sources report up to 5 mm)
parameters.description: Tolerance specification for panel gaps to quantify seam uniformity and visual/build quality; tighter tolerances improve perceived precision and can affect aerodynamics. / 面板间隙公差，用于量化接缝均匀性和视觉/制造质量；更严格的公差提升感知精度并可能影响空气动力学。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Drive tighter dimensional targets, prioritize continuous surfaces and select processes that expose hand-finish cues.

parameters.range: Reported values vary by vehicle and context. Examples and reported values include single-rated figures (e.g., 93 CV), example ranges such as 57 CV (Prius) to 262 CV (Model 3), high-performance variants ~1001–1200 CV (Veyron), and historical low examples like 48 hp (@1250 rpm).
parameters.description: Maximum engine power output (peak power). Values are reported in different units (CV or hp) and differ by vehicle, trim or measurement methodology; dataset shows both single rated values and broad example ranges.

guidance.howToGuide: Accept modest advertised peak power but emphasize torque delivery and low-rev refinement.

parameters.range: 描述性与定量并存：包括车头长度/舱位/轴距/前后悬等相对比值（可为定性：low-slung / balanced；或定量示例范围：0.5–3.0）；可按车型以 mm 定义 L/W/H 及轴距占比；并可包含特定参考比（例如银比例 ≈2.414:1）
parameters.description: 控制车身纵向与横向的几何分配（hood, cabin, wheelbase, overhangs），决定视觉重心、姿态与家族识别。包含一组比例规则与目标（如轴距/车长比、车高/轴距、舱位与机舱视觉比）用于保持车型群一致性与期望的时代感与美学。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Enforce harmonious front/rear/height ratios, minimal ornamentation levels, continuous surface flows and premium finish standards to achieve an elegant appearance.

parameters.range: 四座可变：常规前向或面对面（face-to-face）

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先采用可旋转面对面座椅布局以营造社交/会客的舱内场景，弱化传统驾驶员控制要素。

parameters.range: 两厢半/两厢半向轿跑尾部过渡（定性）

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在车身总体轮廓上保留两厢半比例，同时将后窗轮廓拉平、降低尾部弧度并缩短直立后悬，从而形成双轿跑式尾部与平台化后备箱轮廓。

parameters.range: matte ↔ high-gloss spectrum; includes textured and accent finishes; gloss examples ~20–90 GU
parameters.description: 外/内饰表面光泽、纹理与涂层选择的总体概念，决定视觉重量、材质感与反射特性。涵盖微观表面特性、涂层均匀性、颜色一致性以及通过面板朝向与角度控制眩光与反射。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Define high-grade surface treatments, consistent texture and color matching across parts to convey refinement.

parameters.range: roughness Ra ~0.01–5 µm (typical visible components 0.1–2.0 µm); gloss ~5–90 GU; other controllable metrics: compressibility tolerances, friction coefficient ranges
parameters.description: 用于将工艺与设计目标落地的可量化指标集合，包含表面粗糙度、光泽等级与零件特定公差，影响外观、触感、耐磨与空气层面行为。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Translate perceived quality goals into measurable surface and tactile targets (gloss, roughness, compressibility, friction) and tolerances.

parameters.range: Typical application-dependent values; numeric Ra commonly 0.1–5.0 µm (frequently 0.1–1.0 µm for fine finishes); also specified qualitatively per material/finish class (soft-touch, textured, smooth); for specific components (e.g. cylinder bores) typical requirements are lower than conventional liner finishes.
parameters.unit: µm (Ra); qualitative scale for material finish grades where applicable
parameters.description: Micro-scale average surface finish (Ra) that characterizes microscopic roughness and tactile surface texture. Impacts sealing, friction, wear, tactile perception and perceived craftsmanship; used for both functional surfaces (e.g. cylinder bores) and interior material finishes.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize low surface roughness, consistent color tolerance and controlled gloss to communicate high material quality.

parameters.range: 20–90; observed in study samples ~72–88 (study samples clustered in this subrange)
parameters.description: Material/surface hardness metric used to quantify rim surface firmness and relate objective hardness to perceived softness and cushioning. Used in studies correlating measured hardness with drivers' perception of rim hardness.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Set objective surface hardness number target (<= 77.5) so users perceive the rim as soft; coordinate with material selection and cushioning.

parameters.parameter: Vibration design targets (RMS magnitude and frequency-based treatment) / 振动设计目标（RMS幅值与频率处理原则）
parameters.description: 将振动设计按频率与接触场景区分：在低频（<20 Hz）以结构隔离与动力学控制为主以降低整车/座舱主导振动（目标示例：座舱主导频带RMS <0.02 g）；对于驾驶员接触点（方向盘、踏板、换挡杆）设定更宽松但以舒适为准的RMS上限（示例 <0.5 m/s^2）；高于20 Hz的感知刺激更多依赖声学处理与隔声/吸声策略。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 定义车辆总体NVH目标（如车内等效声级、垂直/横向/纵向RMS加速度、可感知振动阈值）并转化为可测参数。

parameters.range: 典型范围 2500–3500 mm；常见 2700–3100 mm，按车型级别变化（短轴距→紧凑级；长轴距→中/大型）；示例值包括 2900–3000 mm、2980 mm、3480 mm
parameters.description: 前后车轮中心线之间的轴距。轴距影响后排腿部空间与车内容积、侧面视觉比例与伸展感、转弯半径/通过角以及车身直线稳定性。较长轴距常用于提升乘坐舒适性与豪华感与稳定性；较短轴距有利通过角与机动性。轴距长度也决定轮位与车门/悬长的视觉比例。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 拉长轴距、扩大乘员舱体积并保持较低噪声系数，采用温和而流畅的外观线条以传达豪华感。

parameters.range: 依车型与级别不同：短轴距约2000–2500 mm；紧凑/城市车型常见约2400–2700 mm；MPV/大型车常见约2600–3100 mm；总体观测范围约2000–3200 mm；示例值：2800 mm
parameters.description: 前后车轴中心之间的纵向间距，决定乘员舱长度、车门尺寸与侧面比例；轴距增长通常带来更佳的乘坐舒适性和更大的内部空间，但会影响转弯半径与车身动态特性。轴距设计需和悬挂布局、前/后悬、平台一致性及家族设计语言共同考虑。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Lengthen wheelbase, lower roofline proportionally, refine surfacing and add premium details to increase perceived value and presence.

parameters.parameter: Wheelbase to Overall Length Ratio / 轴距比（轴距/车长）
parameters.range: 0.55-0.75 (typical 0.58-0.64; luxury often towards upper end)
parameters.description: 轴距占整车长度的比例，用于衡量车身包装效率与视觉比例。较高比值表示更短前后悬、更多的可用车内空间，并常被用作家族化视觉识别与豪华感目标。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 增大轴距比以扩大内部空间并营造更稳重、沉稳的视觉姿态，常用于豪华车型。

parameters.range: relative 0..1
parameters.description: Relative extent/weighting of craftsmanship and pleasing-perception enhancements (fit, materials, surface treatments).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize materials, tolerances, surface treatments and color harmonization to enlarge the pleasing-perception layer and increase perceived product value.
将价格区间定位于中高端（约30-60万），并优先强化安全性、品牌与服务体验的设计权衡。

parameters.parameter: 内饰材质与做工精细度
parameters.range: 基础-高端
parameters.description: 缝线、包覆材料、软包比例与工艺精度等可量化的内饰参数

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提升内饰材料质感、增加工艺细节与功能配置以满足品位化诉求

parameters.parameter: 后悬相对车轮直径比例
parameters.range: >1 轮直径（S 级示例）
parameters.unit: 无量纲比例 / mm 表示

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 后悬长度超过一车轮直径、机舱盖长度显著并把座舱视觉后置。

parameters.range: 可用相对车长比例表示（相对于轮径：>1 表示长尾偏豪华，<1 偏运动）
parameters.description: 从后轴中心到车尾末端的水平距离（车轮中心线到车尾末端），影响后备箱容积、尾部视觉比例与车辆重心感受。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 缩短前悬、延长后悬以拉长车尾比例，优先保证后备箱容积与低趴姿态。

parameters.parameter: 轴距/车长比（轴长比 / proportionRatio / AxleLengthRatio）
parameters.unit: %（无量纲比值，也可用小数表示）
parameters.description: 轴距相对于整车长度的比例，影响车身修长感、乘坐舒适性与内部空间感受。数值越大通常使车身显得更修长并改善乘坐舒适性；数值较小则体现紧凑性和灵活性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提高轴长比（轴距/车长×100%）以获得修长流畅的车身比例和增强舒适感。

recalled_nodes.label: DesignAttribute(设计属性)
recalled_nodes.name: Adventurous / rugged detailing (冒险/越野化细节)

paths.path: Chromed bumpers and trim -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 复古
paths.reason: 改变层面为材料感知与细节装饰；镀铬前后保险杠和饰件显著提升装饰复杂度与历史感，直接对应 Rubric 中复古的 OrnamentationLevel 与传统表面处理参数，因而稳定强化复古风格。

paths.path: Adventurous / rugged detailing (冒险/越野化细节) -> TypeAssociatedWith -> 中型SUV
paths.reason: 护板、粗犷轮眉与车顶行李架等为中型SUV表达越野能力与探险用途的典型设计特征，语义上足以指向有越野/探险定位的中型SUV。

parameters.range: boxy .. streamlined (low..high; can be described as low - medium - high); 强调平滑的连续曲率，避免突变半径
parameters.description: Vehicle surface curvature and overall shape continuity, including fender integration and roof-to-tail slope; indicates roundedness/streamlining and is influenced by family design language. 局部与全局曲率分布影响层流/湍流转换与尾流分离，要求平滑连续的曲率以减少流体分离并提升空气动力学性能。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Fomentar superficies curvas continuas, reducir aristas y separación entre elementos (guardabarros integrados), buscar volumetría más redondeada.

parameters.range: open — closed (open / exposed → semi‑enclosed → fully enclosed)
parameters.description: Degree of enclosure of the passenger compartment and mechanicals (e.g., open bench, partial hood, full cabin).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Priorizar cabinas totalmente cerradas y eliminar configuraciones de carrocería abiertas; ajustar proporciones para integración de la carrocería.

parameters.range: none to full
parameters.description: Extent of external body panels and coachwork; minimal on early prototypes, full on later coachbuilt cars.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor minimal body coverage and exposed chassis, prioritizing lightness and ease of access over finished coachwork.

parameters.range: open to semi‑enclosed
parameters.description: 乘员舱的封闭程度（如开放式长椅、部分罩棚、完整驾驶舱）。该参数定义车身围蔽与座舱配置的关系，影响视觉开放感、进出便捷性以及热工/声学与安全布局。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Preserve high ride height, tall wheel radius and open, bench‑like seating to maintain carriage typology.

parameters.range: length proportion: 1.8/3.0 (≈60%); overall form: tall/boxy/high-roof (qualitative)
parameters.description: 涵盖车厢在车辆总长中的纵向占比（乘员舱长度占比，约1.8/3.0≈60%）以及车厢体量的形态比例（高度/宽度/长度的关系，偏向高、近似箱式或高顶等）。可用于定量描述纵向分配，也可用于定性描述车厢体量与比例。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 保留箱式车厢体量与垂直车身面，优先采用高顶与直立侧板以延续马车的视觉印象，从而定义早期车身比例参数。

parameters.range: 焊接钢管框架

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先采用可得的焊接钢管与前叉组件，简化制造并保留可识别的机械构件。

parameters.parameter: Consistency of lamp motifs across model range
parameters.range: low consistency -> high consistency
parameters.description: Degree to which lamp shapes, signature lines and animations are shared across different models.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Define shared proportions, signature elements and allowable variations so each model is identifiable as belonging to the family while remaining distinct.

parameters.range: front-mounted

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 以功能优先为原则，优先采用前置发动机以实现更合理的整车布置与冷却通道，形成前置发动机的设计参数。

parameters.parameter: Hood length / deck ratio; proportions (long hood / short deck); Proporciones ejecutivas (long hood / short deck)
parameters.range: Long hood / short rear deck — visually emphasizes an elongated bonnet and compact cabin/rear deck; commonly creates the perception of a forward-mounted (front) engine compressing rear seating space.
parameters.description: A classic GT/executive proportion language: elongated bonnet combined with a compact rear deck that reinforces sporty or luxury family identity through visual emphasis and balance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 以复古比例与特征为可控参数来源，限定车顶线、车身长宽高比例、灯组形状与格栅构成。

parameters.description: 引擎罩或发动机舱长度占整车长度的比率。通常约为0.6（约3/5），在不同车型中常见范围为0.55-0.65。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先拉长引擎罩与前悬，保持车体整体比例向前延伸，使引擎舱占整车较大比重（约60%）以呈现贵族化长引擎罩形象。

parameters.range: 概念/比例/节奏规则（描述性）
parameters.description: 车身表面线条与构架布局参数，来源于古建筑的线性与构成法则，用于控制面缝、腰线、翼子板轮廓等。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 从古建筑的线条、结构与对称布局中提取节奏与比例准则，用以定义车身表面线条、腰线节奏与整体比例关系，确保传统元素与现代整车语言自然融合。

parameters.range: Latón predominante en superficies exteriores y adornos

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Priorizar latón en superficies visibles y elementos decorativos; restringir paleta de materiales a acabados metálicos pulidos.

parameters.range: per seating layout and target occupant percentile; varies by vehicle class (compact → full-size)
parameters.description: Seating envelope and reference locations that define occupant position, reach and clearance; space allocation and arrangement of vehicle systems and occupants — includes seating positions, legroom, headroom, and storage volumes for luggage and items.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): keep cabin elevated and upright, preserving coach-like seating position and high floor

parameters.parameter: OrnamentationLevel; ornamentation_level; Nivel de ornamentación; 装饰等级
parameters.range: none, low, medium, high (离散等级；等价表示：none..high)
parameters.description: 衡量装饰与工艺复杂度的参数，影响象征性与社会识别度。/ Measures the degree of ornamentation and craftsmanship complexity; affects symbolism and social recognition.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Incrementar elementos ornamentales: apliques, lámparas externas, cantoneras y molduras de latón.

parameters.range: flat → highly curved
parameters.description: Curvature of individual body panels that shapes local highlights, edge behavior and transitions between surfaces. 用于单板造型与细节控制。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Promote increased panel multiple curvature and smooth continuous surfaces to achieve bulbous volumes.

parameters.range: model-dependent; per-unit low → high (examples: '↓ per unit', 'low', '<£10,000')
parameters.unit: currency (typ. reported per-unit in USD; GBP and other currencies possible)
parameters.description: 制造与装配整个产品的直接和间接成本总和，通常是价值工程的直接调节对象；决定组件/产品能否量产并广泛采用的关键因素。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor simple geometries, minimal part count, compact proportions and standardized components to reduce production cost and complexity.

parameters.range: techo alto; larga distancia entre ejes; carrocería relativamente estrecha; incluye proporciones específicas de capot, cabina y emblema
parameters.description: Conjunto de parámetros de proporción y detalles iconográficos que definen la familia, aplicado al estilo de carrocería tipo carruaje (proporciones clave de capot, cabina y emblema).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Adoptar proporciones derivadas del carruaje: techo alto, distancia entre ejes larga y silueta vertical.

parameters.range: 描述性与定量并存：包括车头长度/舱位/轴距/前后悬等相对比值（可为定性：low-slung / balanced；或定量示例范围：0.5–3.0）；可按车型以 mm 定义 L/W/H 及轴距占比；并可包含特定参考比（例如银比例 ≈2.414:1）
parameters.description: 控制车身纵向与横向的几何分配（hood, cabin, wheelbase, overhangs），决定视觉重心、姿态与家族识别。包含一组比例规则与目标（如轴距/车长比、车高/轴距、舱位与机舱视觉比）用于保持车型群一致性与期望的时代感与美学。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 设定低矮车身、短前悬或中置发动机的比例目标以形成GT式低重心姿态与优雅轮廓。

parameters.parameter: Rear overhang / spoiler integration; 后悬/尾部体积
parameters.range: extended to accommodate wing mounting; generally large (较大)
parameters.description: Packaging and structural parameters for mounting large aerodynamic devices; the rear overhang length and rear volume determine the visual 'big butt' appearance. （用于安装大尺寸空气动力学装置的包装与结构参数；尾部外廓的后伸距离与体积决定视觉上的“ 大屁股”感受。）

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先放大后部体量、降低尾部收束，允许较大后悬和宽厚的跨面，追求视觉饱满度。

parameters.range: stepped / moderate slope / fully sloped or vertical; defined by packaging and deflector integration
parameters.description: Geometry/shape of the rear deck/rear end that determines flow separation and aerodynamic behavior (including convertible conditions). Typical forms include stepped deck, moderate slope, fully sloped or vertical; the exact geometry is constrained by packaging and integration of deflectors and related components.

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): Adopt a stepped rear deck (compromise between sloped streamlined and vertical tail) to moderate vortex shedding while maintaining trunk volume and rear passenger comfort.

parameters.range: open / soft-top / hard-top
parameters.description: 车顶类型与有无直接影响乘员暴露度、整车质量和风阻表现。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 鼓励保留无篷或轻量可折叠篷布的构型，保持开放乘坐布局与高坐姿，延缓封闭车身的采用以兼顾轻量化与早期动力限制。

parameters.range: 0–30° (典型约5–15°，对应gentle to moderate fastback)
parameters.description: 车顶后倾角度，直接影响气流分离和整车阻力系数。Roofline slope (rearward roof inclination) affects airflow separation and drag coefficient.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过强调前低后高的侧线来调整车顶坡度与前后高度差，从而形成楔形侧廓并传递速度感。

parameters.range: continuous, smooth → moderate-to-high curvature (可调：平滑→轻微凹凸/平缓→急变)，用于局部与整体造型调节
parameters.description: Local and global curvature of body panels controlling highlights, reflections and perceived volume. 决定外观卷曲程度、光影效果与面与线的光学连接（影响优雅感与运动感）。可用曲率半径或无量纲描述表示。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过优先使用连续曲面、软化过渡和去除尖锐折线来塑造车身外形与比例（低矮姿态、长窗格与协调轮拱）。

parameters.range: 5 - 2000 mm（局部到大面；常见范围 50 - 2000 mm）
parameters.description: 车身外形曲率控制，影响气流附着与视觉流线感。决定面与面之间过渡的平滑程度，较大半径产生更饱满、柔和的外形；不同区域曲率半径差异显著。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 放大曲率半径、提高正横剖体积与面连续性以获得饱满视觉

parameters.range: 概念化比例/造型深度（设计上下限由整车比例决定）
parameters.description: 后部轮廓参数，表现为外圈形态包裹内嵌细节，用于灯组、后备箱盖与保险杠的关系设定。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将古建筑的‘外圈内嵌’构图等造型理念转译为尾部轮廓与灯组造型，形成具有文化指向性的车尾识别手法（示例：红旗H9的车尾设计示范）。

parameters.range: none..multi-gear; common types: manual, automatic, dual-clutch, CVT; other/legacy forms: chain drive; example offered configurations: 2 manual + 1 three-speed automatic
parameters.description: Indicates whether a transmission is present and its type/complexity—ranging from no transmission to multi‑gear systems. Covers conventional categories (manual, automatic, dual-clutch, CVT), alternative drives (chain drive) and specific market/configuration offerings. Influences packaging, weight, efficiency and driving characteristics.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor adoption of shaft (cardan) transmission and steering-wheel based control to present a modern, ergonomic vehicle layout.

parameters.range: Varies by vehicle type and era — generally from small up to very large; examples include effective small volumes for convertibles/battery‑packed vehicles and design targets >450 L for practical/utility-focused models. Historically trunk volumes increased (notably in 1950s–70s US cars).
parameters.unit: liters (L); can also be reported categorically (small/medium/large)
parameters.description: Volume of the rear luggage compartment. Relative increases compared with earlier compact rear‑sloped designs have occurred historically. Effective usable volume can be substantially reduced by convertible roof mechanisms, battery packaging, spare tire, or other packaging constraints. Some design targets specify volumes above 450 L to balance utility and styling.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Enlarge rear luggage compartment to create a pronounced rear volume (stepped rear deck) so passenger cell sits centrally relative to fore/aft mass distribution.

parameters.range: 200-2500 kg（总体观测）；典型 600-1800 kg；设计目标：在符合包装与安全约束下尽量减小
parameters.description: 整车质量（整备质量/车重），影响加速、能耗、操控、气动、税制与分类。设计目标是在满足安全与包装约束下尽量减轻，用以指导材料与结构选择。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Minimize mass via structural efficiency, use lightweight materials and integrated body structure to target very low curb weight.

parameters.range: 3 or 4 (observed values: 3; 4)
parameters.description: Number of wheels; influences vehicle stability, steering system, packaging/footprint and overall stance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Retain a four-wheel layout and large-diameter wheels to preserve carriage proportions and perceived stability.

parameters.range: 约 1–2000 mm（≈0.001–2.0 m）；典型示例：小尺度曲率 ≈30 mm， 大尺度曲线 ≈500 mm；具体取值依车型及细节而定
parameters.unit: mm（主单位）；m（亦常用，1 m = 1000 mm）
parameters.description: 曲面或关键线的局部曲率半径，用于衡量曲面的弯曲程度。对车身气动行为（如边界层发展与分离位置）、视觉光影过渡与面感均有影响，关键线曲率尤其影响光影过渡与面感。

guidance.howToGuide: 建议设计参数增大局部曲率半径，降低突兀的折线，提升面与面的平滑过渡。

parameters.parameter: 整体圆润车身形态 / ContourRoundness
parameters.range: 连续曲率 / 无锐角；可量化为 0-10 视觉尺度
parameters.unit: 描述性（可用 0-10 量表进行量化）
parameters.description: 家族化的圆润轮廓参数，指导曲率半径、连接过渡等具体几何控制；同时描述车身轮廓的视觉圆滑程度，数值越高表示轮廓越饱满圆润。可作为几何约束（保证连续曲率、避免锐角）与视觉量化指标并用。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提高车身轮廓的整体圆润度（ContourRoundness 7-10/10），以形成明显的圆滚屁股视觉重心。

parameters.parameter: 面间过渡半径与整体曲率量化
parameters.range: 同上

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先增大面曲率半径与面间过渡半径，降低折线数量以实现视觉上的饱满与流动性。

parameters.range: 约5-25 deg（常见有效范围约5-15°）
parameters.description: 尾部倾斜角度（包括车尾与地面夹角），决定尾部涡流强度、尾流恢复与流动分离位置，直接影响车辆风阻与尾部压力分布及稳定性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过增加尾部后倾角、减小迎风面积并优化尾部曲率来降低流动分离与形状阻力，从而降低整车Cd。

parameters.range: 城市微型偏短；相对于战前比例通常更长 (longer relative to pre-war proportions)
parameters.description: 整车长度，对视觉姿态有直接影响。Primary overall proportion influencing visual stance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Increase overall length and width while lowering roofline and reducing visual height to create a 'long-low-wide' silhouette; emphasize overhangs and extended rear.
鼓励延长轴距与车身总长以增强外观的宏伟感与内部空间暗示。

parameters.range: 低-高

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先增加曲线强度与装饰复杂度，减弱功能约束下的简洁性优先级

parameters.description: 棱线深度是从面板表面到折线槽底的垂直距离（即折线相对于相邻面之间的高度差），决定阴影、光影对比和立体感的强弱。

guidance.howToGuide: 在保留原始形态特征的同时采用现代比例与曲面处理，调整棱线深度与曲率以适应当代制造与审美。

parameters.range: 典型示例 1500–1800 mm；设计上可从较高（箱型）到较低（流线）以影响内部空间与空气动力学
parameters.description: 车体垂直高度的绝对尺寸，是影响车内头部空间、重心高度与整车姿态的重要参数（原数据中出现'm'单位项已统一为mm）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 保持垂直侧面与较大的车厢容积；在需要提升速度时，指导性调整为逐步降低车身高度以减小迎风阻力。

parameters.range: 低-高（包含低屋顶/中等屋顶等）
parameters.description: 车辆或前后座舱最高点到地面的垂直高度，影响室内头部空间、侧面比例与整车姿态。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 要求降低整体车顶高度、减少车身剖面厚度与玻璃面积，强化水平腰线

parameters.range: 5°–45° (typical 5°–35°; by vehicle type: sedans ~10°–15°; city SUVs ~20°–25°; off-road SUVs ~25°–35°; extreme off-road up to ~45°)
parameters.description: 几何参数，表示车前/后部与地面交点形成的角度，直接影响越野通过能力、保险杠碰撞风险与视觉高底盘感。Determines whether vehicle extremities will contact obstacles when approaching/descending; affects off-road traversal capability and bumper clearance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先提高接近角（更大的角度），通过缩短前悬、提高离地间隙和高位前保险杠造型来实现；按整车类型设定目标范围。

parameters.description: Angle between the ground and the vehicle's lowest front part (front bumper/front edge). Determines ability to approach obstacles and off-road clearance; influenced by front overhang and ground clearance.

guidance.howToGuide: Specify target approach, breakover and departure angles to enable obstacle traversal; derived from wheelbase, overhangs and wheel radius.

parameters.range: 取决于轴距与离地间隙；短轴距且高离地间隙可产生较大通过角
parameters.description: 底盘最低点与前后轮接地点连线所成夹角，决定跨越凸起障碍时底盘是否会接触。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过优化轴距（WB）、提高离地间隙（GC）与提高底盘最低点位置来增大通过角。

parameters.range: Typically 5°–50° depending on vehicle; common examples: passenger cars ~10°–15°, typical overall 16°–30°, city SUVs 20°–30°, hard‑core off‑road vehicles 30°–50°.
parameters.description: Angle between the ground and the lowest rear component or the angle formed by a line tangent to the rear wheels and the ground; affects ramp clearance, rear bumper scraping risk, off‑road departure capability and perceived ground clearance. / 车尾突出点或后轮切线与地面的夹角，影响爬坡/下坡通过性、后保险杠刮擦风险、越野离地能力及视觉高底盘感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过减短后悬（ROH）、提高离地间隙（GC）和采用高位后保险杠等设计来增大离去角。

parameters.range: FWD / RWD / AWD(4WD)

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize AWD/4WD architectures, increased ground clearance and reinforced underbody within design parameters.

parameters.range: 机械 4WD、electric AWD、或按需全轮/车轮级可变分配（fully variable per wheel）
parameters.unit: qualitative / Nm for torque values where applicable
parameters.description: 规定传动系架构（例如耐用的机械4WD或电驱动 AWD），以及为越野、牵引能力或操控优先的扭矩曲线与分配策略。支持按需将扭矩在车轮间动态分配以优化牵引力与稳定性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify 4WD layouts and motor/gear ratios that favor low-speed, high-torque delivery; accept taller powertrain packaging.

parameters.range: 峰值约 600-650 Nm；峰值转速区间 500-2500 rpm；最大扭矩示例 600 Nm @ 2500 rpm
parameters.unit: Nm；曲线单位 N·m vs rpm
parameters.description: 发动机在不同转速下的扭矩输出形态，影响驾驶响应与牵引能力。设计关注低转速扭矩以提高牵引与重载起步性能；常见目标峰值约 600-650 Nm（示例：EB110 约 620 Nm）。扭矩曲线用于评估各工况下的可用扭矩点并指导传动比与换挡策略。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize high low-end torque targets and drivetrain durability; influence gear ratios and final drive selection.

parameters.parameter: Front overhang (front wheel centre to front extremity)
parameters.range: Design targets favor as short as feasible; typical reference ranges vary (commonly ~300–600 mm; some sources list up to ~600–1200 mm) depending on vehicle class and packaging
parameters.description: Distance from front wheel centre to the foremost bodywork. Affects front visual proportion, hood/bonnet slope, approach angle, crash packaging, airflow initiation and cabin set-back/interior packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 缩短前悬、适当增大后悬以优化接近角与离去角，提高越野通过性。

parameters.parameter: Frontal Area / FrontalArea / 迎风面积 / A
parameters.range: Typical 1.8–3.0 m² (reported examples: 1.8–2.4; 1.8–2.8; up to 3.0) — vehicle-class dependent
parameters.description: 车辆正面投影面积（迎风面积），是空气阻力计算的关键参数。受车身整体外廓、翼子板体积、保险杠与格栅造型及设计包装约束，按车型级别有典型范围。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Free design parameters toward utility and rugged proportions (larger frontal area, higher clearance).

parameters.range: Typical 110-300 mm; varies from low (sedan) to high (off-road); qualitative descriptions: elevated/high
parameters.description: 离地间隙，影响离地视觉高度、通过性与空气动力学布置。Minimum distance between the vehicle underbody/lowest structural point and the ground; critical for off-road capability, urban ramp traversal, ride height and visual stance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提高离地间隙并强化底板结构以实现越野通过性和防护需求。

parameters.description: Minimum upward suspension travel (jounce) for the axle assembly to allow articulation on extreme off-road terrain.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Require minimum jounce travel and increased packaging space under engine to ensure axle articulation and durability.

parameters.range: 1450-1910 mm; subject to aerodynamic targets and packaging constraints
parameters.description: Vertical exterior dimension affecting aerodynamic profile and interior headroom; constrained by aerodynamic targets and packaging needs. 车高影响视野、通过性与车身姿态；SUV通常偏高以实现越野/通过性与霸气感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 强调高底盘与挺拔车身，轴距常见2700–3100mm，车长常见4600–5200mm；车高显著高于轿车（可达1700–1910mm）。

parameters.range: 典型范围 500-2000 kg，具体数值随车型而异
parameters.description: 车辆可安全承载的最大货物与乘员质量。该参数用于确定货箱、悬架的尺寸与强度需求。

guidance.howToGuide: Set targets for payload, towing and minimum ground clearance for off-road capability

parameters.range: RampAngleMax (safety recommendation for independent wheelchair use): <= 12°; ramp_over_angle (example typical): ~12–14°; approach_angle (example typical): ~14–28°; departure_angle (example typical): ~16–20°
parameters.description: Geometric angles defined by wheel positions and front/rear overhangs that affect obstacle negotiation and ramp usability. Includes a specific safety guideline: maximum usable ramp incline for safe independent wheelchair use (RampAngleMax) is generally <= 12°. Other related geometric/example ranges: ramp-over angle ~12–14°; approach angle ~14–28°; departure angle ~16–20°.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify larger approach (e.g., up to ~28°), departure (e.g., up to ~20°) and ramp-over angles to clear obstacles.

parameters.parameter: Rear overhang / rear overhang length (distance from rear wheel centre/axle to rearmost body)
parameters.range: Depends on vehicle class and packaging: hatchbacks/compact ~200–450 mm; typical passenger cars often 600–900 mm; reported design ranges vary—overall 200–900 mm depending on layout and requirements
parameters.description: Length of vehicle body beyond the rear axle/wheel centre. Influences departure angle, rear packaging (cargo, spare/EV components), suspension and differential packaging, hatch geometry/angle, and overall rear proportions.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 增大后悬以提升离去角，同时兼顾载物与后悬挂布置。

parameters.range: system dependent; typical chassis ride height 120-160 mm; rear ride height 60-220 mm; adjustable systems ± (commonly +30 to +80 mm relative adjustment); variants range from low (aero) to high (off‑road)
parameters.description: Vertical distance from road/curb line to a chassis reference (ground clearance). Influences centre of gravity, perceived stance, ride comfort, aerodynamics and off‑road capability. Values and measurement points are system/vehicle dependent; normally specified at empty vehicle condition with fluids per package note.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): specify increased static ride height and higher suspension jounce stops to achieve required ground clearance and cargo capability

parameters.parameter: Side rail section type (侧轨截面类型)
parameters.range: open channel | closed box

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先保证适配性与承载需求：对轻/重商用车强调梯形/深梁侧轨（bending stiffness），在追求更高扭转刚度时引导采用闭合箱形横梁/侧框。

parameters.range: independent | non-independent (solid axle, torsion beam, live axle) | MacPherson (McPherson) | double-wishbone | multi-link | transverse leaf (front) | semi-elliptic (rear)

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor non-independent systems (solid/live axle, leaf springs, torsion beam) to maximize articulation, simplicity and load robustness.

parameters.range: ≈70–85% (truck/SUV focused) ; typical passenger average ≈55–65%
parameters.description: Ratio of sidewall height to tire width; controls effective tire height, load distribution and ride compliance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify a higher tire aspect ratio (taller sidewall) and reinforced sidewall construction to distribute loads and protect the rim from rock damage.

parameters.description: 轮胎高度/轮胎宽度×100%，影响侧壁高度、离地高度与操控感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提升胎高比、提高离地高度与轮胎侧壁高度以增加通过性与减震性能；可配合增大轮胎整体直径。

parameters.range: Approx. 80–400 mm depending on vehicle class; passenger cars ≈80–150 mm, off‑road/extreme vehicles ≈200–400 mm
parameters.description: Maximum usable vertical displacement of the wheel relative to the chassis; determines available wheel movement for ride compliance, damping requirements and ride height variation under load. Extreme off‑road vehicles require the upper end of the range.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify increased wheel travel ranges and simpler axle layouts to ensure wheel contact and articulation in off-road conditions.

parameters.range: 依车型与级别不同：短轴距约2000–2500 mm；紧凑/城市车型常见约2400–2700 mm；MPV/大型车常见约2600–3100 mm；总体观测范围约2000–3200 mm；示例值：2800 mm
parameters.description: 前后车轴中心之间的纵向间距，决定乘员舱长度、车门尺寸与侧面比例；轴距增长通常带来更佳的乘坐舒适性和更大的内部空间，但会影响转弯半径与车身动态特性。轴距设计需和悬挂布局、前/后悬、平台一致性及家族设计语言共同考虑。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 轴距与整车长度按中型越野SUV比例配置以保持经典姿态与车内空间平衡。

parameters.range: elevated (典型紧凑越野取值较高)

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将越野气质转化为可控的设计参数：提高离地间隙、缩短前后悬、放大轮拱间距并增加护板尺寸与视觉厚重感。

parameters.range: 综合观测：80–350 mm；典型城市/轿车约100–220 mm；越野/SUV/皮卡常见180–350 mm；文档中亦出现180–320 mm、90–220 mm等区间及示例增量（+15 mm）。
parameters.description: 车辆最低点（底盘或轮拱底部）到地面的垂直距离。该参数直接影响通过性与越野能力、空气动力学（风阻与升力）、视觉姿态、底盘保护、重心分布与驾驶感受，是车身定位、护板高度与气动目标之间的重要设计权衡项。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): specify higher ride height and larger suspension travel to meet functional off-road angles

parameters.range: jounce (compression) 0 — design jounce max (e.g., 0–60 mm typical; project-specific); typical total travel by vehicle class: sports 75–90 mm; passenger 100–120 mm; trucks/SUVs 125–150+ mm
parameters.description: Vertical wheel travel parameter covering both compression (jounce) and rebound. The jounce sub-parameter commonly references compression envelope sections (0 to design jounce max). Total travel values vary by vehicle class.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify long suspension travel (>=125-150mm) to allow greater wheel articulation and vertical movement.

parameters.range: torsion_bar | coil_spring | leaf_spring | solid_axle / live_axle | heavy-duty independent
parameters.description: Categorical parameter indicating suspension architecture and spring/axle type. Examples include torsion bar, coil or leaf springs, solid/live axles and heavy-duty independent setups. (Note: torsion bar was favored for the original Renault 4 design.)

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor solid axle solutions when durability and vertical wheel travel without camber change are required.

parameters.description: Target overall tyre (assembled) diameter to be used as a starting package parameter.

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritise wheel/tire choices that balance load capacity, traction and packaging; prefer larger overall tyre diameter with appropriate profile width for load-carrying and off-road robustness.

parameters.description: 整车高度数值，影响视觉体态。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提高车高并配合宽轮距/轮眉设计，形成魁梧壮硕的体态视觉。

parameters.range: contracted <= 3.0-3.5 m; extended up to 4.0-4.5 m
parameters.description: 整车长度 4890 mm，配合轴距与悬长形成传统越野比例。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 保持接近 4890 mm 的车长以保证传统中大型越野的视觉比例与空间表现。

parameters.range: continuous curve following pillar/roof-rail/sill intersections

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify aperture cut lines (P1/P2) to align with weld flanges and hinge/latch locations so seals can be mounted over flanges producing a soft visual opening.

parameters.range: up to 160

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Set autonomous operating range appropriate for battery and mission profile (fleet urban operation), e.g., ~160 km between charges.

parameters.range: continuous / loop-like
parameters.description: 车身线条是否保持一体化的连续流动形态，避免明显分段和突兀收口。

guidance.guidanceStrategy: 优先形成单一连续体表面，减少断裂线条，使用流动线条贯穿前后坐标，强化连续性概念。

parameters.range: one-box
parameters.description: 消除明显的三厢分隔，以单一体量提供乘员与载物空间。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 以功能优先和形式纯粹为原则，推动从三厢/两厢向单厢（one-box）单体空间布局的转变，减少多余分段与装饰。

parameters.range: fade-out at both ends

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 棱线不采用硬切断，而是通过减薄/渐淡到表面过渡，使棱线视觉强度在两端渐弱。

parameters.description: Curb/vehicle weight (mass of vehicle without occupants or cargo). Source records reference a broad set of values reflecting different vehicles, eras, or measurement/reporting differences. Representative reported examples: ~520 kg (≈500–550 kg), 615 kg, ≈635 kg, 970–1160 kg. One record contains 6000 kg which is likely erroneous.

guidance.howToGuide: Limit materials and structure to achieve low curb weight; accept simpler finishes and compact packaging to reach ~615 kg.

parameters.range: Depends on panel/door geometry and packaging: lateral (inboard→outboard; component-level lateral positions), circumferential around an aperture (沿周向/沿车门周边), longitudinal fore/aft offset (front cut line), variable curvature and termination; variable depending on panel geometry
parameters.unit: mm; relative (panel width %); angular position; qualitative (position/curve)
parameters.description: Geometric definition of panel cut lines including location (lateral, circumferential, longitudinal), curvature, termination and alignment to character lines. Defines removable/hinged panel borders and maximum aperture geometry, affects clear aperture, visual seam location, packaging and ingress/egress (e.g. foot swing and seating entry).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将切缝位置与孔口结构（轮拱、门槛、车顶导轨）对齐，使切缝沿孔口边缘延展以形成连续视觉线条。

parameters.range: 位于孔口结构包络内或沿其边缘追踪

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 建议将门边界置于孔口结构内部，并沿孔口走向追踪（围绕轮拱、门槛与车顶导轨），以保持外观连贯性。

parameters.range: 常见/记录范围：~594–748 cc（小型/轻型车，如轻型车级别）；1,327–1,998 cc（中小级别示例）；2,000–4,000 cc（较大发动机）。记录的极端值可达 50,000 cc（文献/档案中记载，属异常值）。
parameters.unit: cc (等同于 mL); 有时与功率相关表述为 cc / kW
parameters.description: 发动机排量（engine capacity）直接影响输出功率与车辆性能。不同车辆类别对应不同排量：轻型车/微型车集中在数百 cc，常见乘用车在 ~1,300–2,000 cc，较大/商用车可达数千 cc。混合动力或增程/复合动力系统通常可采用减小的发动机排量（典型减幅约 −20% 至 −50% 或按等效功率计）。50,000 cc 为文献中记录的极端值，应视为例外/特殊情况。

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize small-displacement engine and lightweight construction; reduce decorative elements and complexity to lower cost and mass.

parameters.description: 意象板图片数量。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 控制意象图数量与多样性，避免过多图像导致感觉分散。

parameters.description: 用于控制用于表达核心感觉的关键词数量。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 限制关键词数量以保证聚焦（通常为1–2词）。

parameters.parameter: Mass; Mass / Weight; Mass and center of gravity
parameters.range: Vehicle total mass typically ~1963 kg; component masses vary (g..kg); CG location depends on material choices and placement
parameters.description: Vehicle mass (weight) conditions acceleration and dynamics; center of gravity (height and position) affects stability and handling. Mass and CG depend on material choices and component placement.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritizes material selection, thin-walled structures and compact packaging targets to reduce mass while retaining perceived robustness.

parameters.range: Varies by vehicle class and era. Documented/claimed values in the set span from single digits up to ~175 km/h. Representative examples: 4; 16; 25; up to 40; 100; 100–150; 150; 152–175; suggested design ranges e.g. 100–200 km/h.
parameters.description: Design target or documented maximum vehicle speed. Influenced by engine power, gearing, aerodynamics and intended use (urban/regional/performance). Values differ by historical era, variant and target use — e.g. historical vehicles show very low absolute speeds, performance models target higher speeds, and urban/regional vehicles target modest maxima to balance drag and efficiency.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize low top speed, conservative operating range, minimal physical controls and maximized sensor field-of-view to suit urban shared autonomous operation.

parameters.range: 描述性与定量并存：包括车头长度/舱位/轴距/前后悬等相对比值（可为定性：low-slung / balanced；或定量示例范围：0.5–3.0）；可按车型以 mm 定义 L/W/H 及轴距占比；并可包含特定参考比（例如银比例 ≈2.414:1）
parameters.description: 控制车身纵向与横向的几何分配（hood, cabin, wheelbase, overhangs），决定视觉重心、姿态与家族识别。包含一组比例规则与目标（如轴距/车长比、车高/轴距、舱位与机舱视觉比）用于保持车型群一致性与期望的时代感与美学。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过限定座舱占比、车顶线与腰线比例范围，平衡实用空间与视觉轻盈感，从而在造型上体现功能驱动的优雅。

parameters.range: high curvature (rounded) — low curvature (sharp)
parameters.description: Controls fullness and roundness of the rear silhouette; 影响后部视觉丰盈感与空气流动分离点。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Increase rear curvature radius, emphasize continuous silhouette and minimize abrupt edges to achieve plump visual volume.

parameters.range: continuous / through-line (full-span) — partial / local
parameters.description: 描述腰线是否贯穿全车侧面或仅为局部段落，用于表达视觉连贯性或分段设计 (whether the beltline runs continuously along the body or is interrupted/partial).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 要求腰线保持较平直的形状并尽量从前至后贯穿，形成家族化侧面轮廓。

parameters.range: 少 (1-3 条可见主棱线)

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 限定侧面可见棱线数量、强调腰线贯穿性并规定线条总体朝向与节奏，以确保家族化识别度和视觉统一性。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 保持侧面轮廓和腰线的水平延伸、立柱竖直与横线平直，以接近 90° 的夹角构成视觉秩序感。

parameters.parameter: 表面平整度 / 表面光顺度 / 外表平滑度（flushness）
parameters.range: 定性：高 | 中 | 低；视觉等级：差 → 优；定量：完全贴合 → 轻微缝隙（mm）
parameters.description: 评估车身面板大面连续性、曲率控制与缝隙可视度，反映外观流畅性与装配做工精度。数值越优表示面板连续性更好、缝隙更小，视觉上更趋于极简与科技感，常用于造型设计评估与质量控制的综合指标。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 限制零碎装饰、优先大面处理与隐藏连接件

parameters.description: 控制轮廓从写实到高度抽象的程度，影响识别性与视觉简洁性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过抽象化轮廓与形态提炼来控制整体识别性与视觉简洁度，定义轮廓提炼强度与细节符号化程度作为可控参数。

parameters.range: 低-高（包含低屋顶/中等屋顶等）
parameters.description: 车辆或前后座舱最高点到地面的垂直高度，影响室内头部空间、侧面比例与整车姿态。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 降低车顶横截面、收紧车窗区域以营造更纤细的侧面轮廓，控制A柱与车顶曲率保持表面清晰性。

paths.path: 品牌豪华SUV_DNA -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 豪华
paths.reason: 该DNA在轮廓/比例/姿态层面（高腰线、宽轮拱）与材料感知/做工层面（精细内饰）及细节/标识层面（强辨识度前脸）同时被强化；根据Rubric，豪华风格受Glass-to-Body Ratio（高腰线降低玻璃比提升实感）、Surface Finish/DisplayMaterialSelection与Interior Finish（精细内饰提升材质与工艺感）、以及Signature Elements（辨识度强的前脸强化品牌识别）等参数直接控制，故这些特征的有意识强化能稳定传达豪华风格。

paths.path: 豪华家族DNA -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 豪华
