recalled_nodes.label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
recalled_nodes.name: driver-isolated front-row layout (驾驶员单独安排的前排布局)

recalled_nodes.label: VehiclePosture(汽车姿态)
recalled_nodes.name: Driver-left oriented cabin layout (驾驶员左向座舱布局)

paths.path: driver-isolated front-row layout (驾驶员单独安排的前排布局) -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 运动
paths.reason: 将驾驶员单独安排并强化以驾驶员为中心的座舱改变了乘员包装与座舱比例（座椅/驾驶舱尺寸、H‑point、座位布局与驾驶舱紧凑度），这些正是Rubric中运动风格通过‘Seating and cockpit dimensions / Seating Layout / H‑point / cockpit tightness’等参数来表达的，长期强化会稳定传达以驾驶性能为核心的运动化定位。

paths.path: Driver Lateral Position -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 运动
paths.reason: 该参数属于座舱包装与交互层面，改变驾驶员横向位置会显著影响车内质量分布与车辆绕垂直轴的极转动惯量，从工程与感知上强化‘以操控为先’的姿态与驾驶者中心感；依据 Rubric 中关于运动风格的 Seating and cockpit dimensions、H-point 及重心/Polar Moment of Inertia 等参数，该改变在多车型与工程目标下稳定地支持运动风格的表达。

paths.path: 跑车用户 -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 运动
paths.reason: 节点表达的是面向跑车/高性能消费者的“运动/冲击”偏好，主动强化该偏好会在比例与姿态层面（如低矮车顶、长前机舱、宽轮距、低离地高度）及细节层面（如深棱线、锐利边缘、大直径轮毂）有一致的造型取向。对应 Rubric 中的运动参数（如 Roofline slope/车顶后倾角、Ride height/离地高度、wheelbase/overhang、Wheel Diameter/轮毂直径、crease depth/棱线深度 等），这些有意识的设计调整会稳定地强化‘运动’风格的感知。

paths.path: Wheels close to occupants -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 运动
paths.reason: 该特征通过将车轮推向乘员舱角落改变了整车纵向比例与轮位分布（短前/后悬、高轮位占比），降低极性惯性并营造宽展、低矮的姿态，稳固强化运动感；对应Rubric的wheelbase/overhang/track width与车身姿态（stance）等参数。

paths.path: Driver-left oriented cabin layout (驾驶员左向座舱布局) -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 运动
paths.reason: 该特征属于交互/姿态层面，座舱、控制台与显示向驾驶侧偏置会强化驾驶员中心化的人机交互和紧凑驾驶舱姿态，从而稳固传达以驾驶体验为核心的运动化定位；对应 Rubric 中的“Seating and cockpit dimensions (including cockpit tightness & seat lowering)”、“H-point”与“Dash-to-Axle Distance / cabinPosition”等参数，这些参数用以量化并表达驾驶员中心化与运动化姿态，左向偏置是持续可识别的运动化信号。

paths.path: Forward-control driver package -> TypeAssociatedWith -> 微面
paths.reason: Forward-control（驾驶位前置至前轴前方）直接限定了以载货最大化为目标的紧凑箱式布局，历史上典型出现在微面/面包式微型商用车；与当前图谱中“微面”作为微型商用/载货车的典型范围一致。

parameters.description: Target 0-100 km/h acceleration time

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize power-to-weight improvements, wide track, short 0-100s via drivetrain spec and weight reduction

parameters.description: Target acceleration emphasizing performance image.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Maximize low-end torque, minimize mass (power-to-weight), and use transmission tuning to meet 0-60 targets.

parameters.range: short — very long (relative proportion to wheelbase); often long when proportionally extended relative to the passenger compartment.
parameters.description: Length of the vehicle bonnet / front overhang. Contributes to an elongated, pointed silhouette and relates to the vehicle's proportions.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Definir proporciones con capó largo, frente bajo y ángulo de rampa pronunciado para acentuar la cuña.

parameters.description: Peak output target that defines performance character; affects packaging, cooling and perceived aggressiveness.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Set BHP targets as a primary design objective, optimize engine breathing and weight to achieve high peak power rather than just large displacement.

parameters.parameter: C点位置（相对车长的位置）
parameters.range: 靠前/居中/靠后（以车身纵向百分比或绝对距离表示）
parameters.description: C点位置影响视觉重心与前后尾部力量感的传达。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将C点向前布置以前移视觉重心，使引擎盖俯冲度增加，拉长前部线条并增强运动感。

parameters.range: Typical static camber angle ≈ -5° to +5° (vehicle dependent). Camber change under load typically ≈ ±1.5° (vehicle dependent). Change through travel can vary from <1° up to several degrees depending on arm length and geometry; camber curve/gain is tunable and often expressed per mm of travel or per degree of roll.
parameters.description: Camber angle is the angle between the wheel plane and the vertical (positive when the top of the wheel leans outwards). Camber change describes the variation of that angle through suspension travel, under load or during body roll; it is critical to maintaining the tire contact patch and tuning handling. Camber gain/loss can be controlled via suspension geometry and tuning.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify negative camber at cornering that increases with jounce; prioritize geometry that yields predictable camber gain under load.

parameters.description: Curb/vehicle weight (mass of vehicle without occupants or cargo). Source records reference a broad set of values reflecting different vehicles, eras, or measurement/reporting differences. Representative reported examples: ~520 kg (≈500–550 kg), 615 kg, ≈635 kg, 970–1160 kg. One record contains 6000 kg which is likely erroneous.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过减轻车体质量、优化包装与尺寸来直接控制车辆重量，从而提升动力性和外观的运动感。

parameters.range: short — long
parameters.description: Distance from the dashboard/base of the windshield (dash) to the front axle. Used by family DNA to enforce brand-typical proportions (e.g., long dash-to-axle for luxury lineage); extended values create a long-hood/long-stance appearance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Increase dash-to-axle to create a long-hood proportion typical of front-longitudinal-engine RWD sports cars; prioritize visual emphasis on hood length and forward mass.

parameters.range: sliding / scissor / gull-wing / rear-lift / vertical pivot / conventional swing
parameters.description: Selection of door types, hinge configurations and opening kinematics to balance packaging, accessibility and parking envelope. Determines how the door moves relative to the body (upward lift vs lateral swing) and impacts aperture requirements and vehicle packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将门铰链类型与开启弧线设定为向上/近垂直的抬起机构（scissor/vertical pivot），以避免横向外摆所需的侧向空间。

parameters.range: RWD
parameters.description: Rear-wheel drive selected to match front-longitudinal engine layout and performance handling goals.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor rear-wheel drive to reinforce dynamic handling and traditional sports-car character.

parameters.range: RWD primary; AWD optional (AWD achievable via transfer case added ahead of prop shaft)
parameters.description: Longitudinal engine → transmission → prop-shaft → offset fixed rear differential. Primary configuration is RWD; AWD can be provided by adding a transfer case ahead of the prop shaft.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor rear-wheel-drive as primary expression for lightness and driver engagement; allow AWD as an alternative to manage higher power outputs while preserving rear-biased dynamics.

parameters.range: varies (short — long)
parameters.description: Axial/longitudinal length occupied by the engine in the vehicle. Depends on cylinder count and arrangement and directly affects engine bay depth and overall vehicle longitudinal packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 允许并鼓励采用较长或更大尺寸的发动机布局，以满足功率与散热需求，优先动力性而非最小化体积。

parameters.parameter: Engine Location / 发动机位置 / 布置
parameters.range: 前置 / 前中 / 中置 / 中后 / 后置（纵向位置）
parameters.description: 动力装置（内燃机或电机组）相对于车轴与乘舱的纵向布置。常见取值为前置、前中、中置、中后、后置。布置会限制悬架与器件包装，影响驱动牵引、载荷姿态与乘舱长度；历史上布置有从后置向前置的演变。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Adopt longitudinal/front-mid or rear-biased engine placement to shape bonnet length and cabin setback for performance proportions.

parameters.parameter: engine_longitudinal_position; Engine Longitudinal Position (front / mid / rear / underfloor)
parameters.description: 发动机在纵向上的安装位置，相对于前轴的距离，影响配重、转向和内饰包装。Can be represented either as a continuous longitudinal offset (numeric, mm relative to front axle center) or as a categorical location (front / mid / rear / underfloor).

guidance.howToGuide: 优先采用中置或后置纵置布局以集中质量、减小转动惯量并优化瞬态响应

parameters.range: 常见布局包括 front-longitudinal、rear-mid（及其它布局）
parameters.description: 发动机安装位置与朝向（例如前纵置用于长前机舱比例；中置/后置影响操控与姿态）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify front-mounted longitudinal engine packaging to support RWD layout and the long dash-to-axle proportion.

parameters.range: 典型取值宽广，约 50–1000 hp（文献中亦见 0–600 CV）；示例值：113 CV @6500 rpm、345 CV、474 CV、480–550 hp
parameters.description: 发动机输出功率，直接影响加速、最高速与车辆的性能感知。值随车辆类型与时代差异很大，应以具体车型目标为准。

guidance.howToGuide: Drive selection of high peak power, aggressive gearing, weight reduction and minimal driver aids to achieve competition-grade performance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify engine displacement and packaging to align with a performance/luxury character (mid-large displacement, performance tuning).

parameters.range: examples: 1,327 cc; 1,497 cc; 2,936 cc; 3,528 cc; 4,600 cc (various configurations and model examples)
parameters.description: Total swept volume of all cylinders; influences packaging, hood/engine-bay length, weight and external proportions, and correlates with power and character. Specifies available engine sizes that balance economy and sportiness. Examples in sources include small-displacement units (~1.3–1.5 L) up to multi-litre engines (e.g., 3.5–4.6 L); associated power examples noted (e.g., V6 305 CV; V8 5.0 412 CV).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先配置大排量V8发动机作为首要设计参数，以确保强烈的动力感与直观性能属性。

parameters.range: 常见/记录范围：~594–748 cc（小型/轻型车，如轻型车级别）；1,327–1,998 cc（中小级别示例）；2,000–4,000 cc（较大发动机）。记录的极端值可达 50,000 cc（文献/档案中记载，属异常值）。
parameters.unit: cc (等同于 mL); 有时与功率相关表述为 cc / kW
parameters.description: 发动机排量（engine capacity）直接影响输出功率与车辆性能。不同车辆类别对应不同排量：轻型车/微型车集中在数百 cc，常见乘用车在 ~1,300–2,000 cc，较大/商用车可达数千 cc。混合动力或增程/复合动力系统通常可采用减小的发动机排量（典型减幅约 −20% 至 −50% 或按等效功率计）。50,000 cc 为文献中记录的极端值，应视为例外/特殊情况。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 倾向于更大排量、更多缸数与更高功率，同时引入改良制动与机械控制以满足赛用需求。

parameters.description: Actual visible outer wheel diameter (flange) as referenced in wheel appearance tables (e.g., 16 in rim → ~440 mm flange).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Use the rim-inch to flange-mm mapping and choose flange diameter to achieve the target visible wheel proportion; increase flange relative to rim to emphasize wheel presence (typical rim -> flange difference 30–35 mm).

parameters.parameter: Front overhang (front wheel centre to front extremity)
parameters.range: Design targets favor as short as feasible; typical reference ranges vary (commonly ~300–600 mm; some sources list up to ~600–1200 mm) depending on vehicle class and packaging
parameters.description: Distance from front wheel centre to the foremost bodywork. Affects front visual proportion, hood/bonnet slope, approach angle, crash packaging, airflow initiation and cabin set-back/interior packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 建议增加前悬长度与降低前端视觉高度，以将车身重心视觉上向前推，形成向前俯冲的姿态。

parameters.description: 车窗面积相对于车身侧面整体的占比，影响视觉重心、运动感、豪华感以及驾驶视野与安全感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 采用较低的车窗/车身比例（约30%~40%玻璃）以降低视觉重心、强化低矮运动姿态。

parameters.parameter: Ground Clearance (离地间隙) & Ramp Over Angle
parameters.range: Ground clearance: 100-300 mm; Ramp over angle: not specified (degrees)
parameters.description: Ground clearance: vertical distance between the lowest vehicle part and the ground, typically 100–300 mm; constrained by underbody airflow management and other aerodynamic requirements. Ramp over angle: geometric angle describing the vehicle's ability to pass over ramps/obstacles, expressed in degrees; specific range not provided. / 离地间隙：车辆最低部位与地面之间的垂直距离，通常为100–300 mm，受底部气流管理等气动需求约束。Ramp over angle：描述车辆跨越坡道/障碍能力的几何角，以度为单位，未给出具体范围。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提高离地间隙、增大轮拱和提升接近/离去角以强化越野通过性与力量感。

parameters.range: Defined per vehicle class; typical vertical values approximately 300–950 mm overall. Common passenger car vertical ranges ~300–520 mm; seat-specific/target percentile ranges often 350–540 mm; some references use approx. 300–600 mm depending on measurement convention.
parameters.description: Geometric seating reference (seat pivot/hip point) used to define occupant seating position for seat mounting, interior packaging, safety and ergonomics. Affects ingress/egress, visibility and perceived interior roominess. Typically specified relative to the vehicle floor and a reference datum.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将驾驶员H点设低以降低重心并减少迎风面积，从而降低风阻并提升操控响应，代价是进出车门不便。

parameters.range: High responsiveness, reduced body roll

guidance.howToGuide: Optimize mass distribution, suspension kinematics and track width for responsiveness

parameters.range: low-slung, reclined seating; forward-set cabin

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Define seating height, recline and cockpit packaging to produce a deep-set, driver-focused posture consistent across models.

parameters.range: qualitative: large → stable/flat rake; small → sporty/steep rake

guidance.howToGuide: Reduce the wheel-arch-to-hood distance (smaller φ) to create a steeper front rake, lower visual center and sportier appearance.

parameters.description: 下部进气宽度与上部进气宽度的比例或差值，较大值带来更强运动感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先扩大下部进气宽度、增大前脸投影面积和下部开口以强调运动姿态。

parameters.range: steel; aluminum; engineering plastics (ABS, SMC, RIM); fiberglass; carbon-fiber composites; ceramics; other composites; veneers, leathers and coated plastics (low- to high-grade)
parameters.description: Selection of primary body, trim and component materials across interior and exterior (metals, plastics, composites, ceramics, veneers, leathers). Affects appearance, surface texture, weight, structural performance, perceived solidity/value, manufacturability and production processes.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先采用低密度高强度材料、优化部件几何以降低质量并兼顾散热与空气流通。

parameters.range: Varies by vehicle class and era. Documented/claimed values in the set span from single digits up to ~175 km/h. Representative examples: 4; 16; 25; up to 40; 100; 100–150; 150; 152–175; suggested design ranges e.g. 100–200 km/h.
parameters.description: Design target or documented maximum vehicle speed. Influenced by engine power, gearing, aerodynamics and intended use (urban/regional/performance). Values differ by historical era, variant and target use — e.g. historical vehicles show very low absolute speeds, performance models target higher speeds, and urban/regional vehicles target modest maxima to balance drag and efficiency.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize peak power, high-speed gearing and reduced aerodynamic drag to achieve target top speed.

parameters.description: Number of selectable gear ratios (historic 2–3 on some US cars, 4–5 on modern units).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): provide more gear ratios and manual control mechanisms to allow finer engine speed control and active driver involvement

parameters.range: conceptual; examples include layout choices such as Front‑engine / RWD / 2‑seat; supports modular package options
parameters.description: Allocation and organization of interior volumes, seat tracks, cargo zones and service channels, and the space reserved for powertrain; defines overall spatial allocation and modular package choices (e.g., interior volume vs. cargo vs. powertrain).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize two-seat cockpit, front‑engine longitudinal layout, rear‑wheel drive and lightweight construction to express domestic sports identity.

parameters.range: Reported values vary by vehicle and context. Examples and reported values include single-rated figures (e.g., 93 CV), example ranges such as 57 CV (Prius) to 262 CV (Model 3), high-performance variants ~1001–1200 CV (Veyron), and historical low examples like 48 hp (@1250 rpm).
parameters.description: Maximum engine power output (peak power). Values are reported in different units (CV or hp) and differ by vehicle, trim or measurement methodology; dataset shows both single rated values and broad example ranges.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Priorizar parámetros de potencia y transmisión (alta potencia máxima y relaciones cortas/largas combinadas) y optimizar Cd para alcanzar velocidad de punta.

parameters.description: RPM band where maximum horsepower is produced; moved higher for vehicles emphasizing speed and handling.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Shift power curve upward in RPM band (higher peak HP), prioritize lighter weight, higher-revving engines and chassis tuning for handling.

parameters.range: context-dependent; higher is better for performance (examples: 95 CV / 544 kg ≈ 0.175 CV/kg; 182 CV / ~620 kg ≈ 0.29 CV/kg). High example: >250 hp/ton
parameters.description: Power output per unit mass — key indicator of acceleration and dynamic performance. 表示单位质量的动力输出，是衡量车辆加速与性能的关键参数。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过提升发动机输出、减轻车重并优化传动比来提升动力响应与最高速

parameters.range: high/medium/low
parameters.description: Volume allocated for engine, transmission and drivetrain.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Allocate packaging volume and architecture to accommodate larger engines, mechanical transmissions and robust final drives; prioritize layouts that favor performance (e.g., longitudinal configurations).

parameters.range: model-dependent; per-unit low → high (examples: '↓ per unit', 'low', '<£10,000')
parameters.unit: currency (typ. reported per-unit in USD; GBP and other currencies possible)
parameters.description: 制造与装配整个产品的直接和间接成本总和，通常是价值工程的直接调节对象；决定组件/产品能否量产并广泛采用的关键因素。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Control styling and subsystem complexity to keep manufacturing and parts cost within low-budget target (<= £10,000).
prioritize a short front overhang, long hood and large wheel diameter to create a classic performance silhouette

parameters.parameter: Rear overhang / rear overhang length (distance from rear wheel centre/axle to rearmost body)
parameters.range: Depends on vehicle class and packaging: hatchbacks/compact ~200–450 mm; typical passenger cars often 600–900 mm; reported design ranges vary—overall 200–900 mm depending on layout and requirements
parameters.description: Length of vehicle body beyond the rear axle/wheel centre. Influences departure angle, rear packaging (cargo, spare/EV components), suspension and differential packaging, hatch geometry/angle, and overall rear proportions.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 削减后端突出的尾部体量，使尾部轮廓更紧凑以强化前倾感。

parameters.range: comfortable (>880 mm typical for premium sedans)
parameters.description: Fore–aft usable space for rear occupants; typical guidance for comfortable packaging is around or above 880 mm (≈34.6 in).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在底盘和车身包装上权衡，延长乘员舱与适度加长后备厢深度以保持舒适性。

parameters.description: Engine maximum practical rpm and responsiveness; influences exhaust tuning and driver perception.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify high engine speed capability and lightweight rotating components to enable high-rpm power delivery as a styling cue for performance.

parameters.range: 典型名义值与可调范围随车用场景与悬架系统而异；常见数值范围约 80–320 mm（即 0.08–0.32 m），最小许可值常见于 90–160 mm；系统可提供 ±20–50 mm 的调节或按应用定义（application-dependent）；具体值依车辆级别与底盘架构而定
parameters.description: 定义车辆参考点（如簧顶或车身参考点）到地面的垂直距离，直接影响车身姿态、离地间隙、通过性、视觉高度、整车正负气动截面与下扰流、底盘包装与 NVH。也与车身在加速/制动/转向时的俯仰/侧倾/下沉/压缩（roll/dive/squat）控制能力相关。

guidance.howToGuide: 通过降低整车高度、拉长轴距、缩短前后悬、加宽轮距来实现低矮宽扁的超跑比例；同时强调低风阻断面。

parameters.parameter: Roofline Angle / Roof Slope Angle / roofline_angle / roofRakeAngle
parameters.description: Average rearward inclination of the roof from A-pillar toward the rear (roofline rake/slope). 影响车顶溜背感、后备箱空间、内部头部空间以及气动阻力和气流分离（steeper slopes can increase drag if they induce separation; controlled slope supports attached flow）。涵盖快背/溜背设计中常见的取值范围和语义（包括roof rake 表述）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过降低车顶高度、增加前伸低鼻与后抬的车身倾角（roof rake），形成楔形侧廓；强调低风阻轮廓与锐利平面。

parameters.range: varies by segment; optimized between interior headroom and aerodynamic silhouette
parameters.description: Overall vertical envelope of the roof — 车顶最高点的垂直尺寸。决定内部头部空间与外观轮廓，对空气动力学目标和车内包装约束有直接影响。常以车身细分市场和设计意图为依据调整。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Lower roof height by a design delta (e.g., 40–120 mm vs a neutral variant) to reduce visual center of gravity and elongate silhouette.

parameters.range: Varies broadly (low–high); example typical values ~1200–1400 mm for lower sport-oriented designs
parameters.description: 车顶高度可从低到高变化；较低的车顶高度营造低矮姿态，强调运动/性能取向；具体数值随车型和目标定位而定。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 压低车顶线、延长引擎罩、缩短车尾与地面的视觉距离，增大轮胎/轮辋尺寸以增强动感。

parameters.range: 0–30° (典型约5–15°，对应gentle to moderate fastback)
parameters.description: 车顶后倾角度，直接影响气流分离和整车阻力系数。Roofline slope (rearward roof inclination) affects airflow separation and drag coefficient.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过调节车顶线条、轴距与后备厢长度，在视觉上实现低矮运动感同时保证后排乘坐空间与行李容积。

parameters.parameter: Seat height / Seating height / Hip point (cushion top or seating reference above floor/ground)
parameters.description: 座椅坐面顶端或坐姿参考点（臀部点/H30）相对于地面或车内地板的垂直位置；影响上下车便捷性、坐姿舒适性、视野（视点高度）及内饰布局。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify low seat mounting to reduce centre of gravity and convey sporting stance; accept reduced ingress/egress.

parameters.range: 175 mm (implemented compromise); anthropometric target: accommodate 5th–99th percentile; reported design ranges up to 300–500 mm
parameters.description: Available fore-aft travel of the seat after engineering/package compromises. Used to accommodate driver anthropometry (e.g., 5th–99th percentile); reported ranges vary depending on packaging and target user population.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先将设计参数限制在覆盖极端人群（5th–99th percentile）的可调范围内，以实现最小化车体体积同时保证驾驶者适配性。

parameters.range: 1-3; 2+2 (4 seats); 4+2 (GST example)
parameters.description: Seat arrangement and distribution (e.g., 2+2 coupe layout, 4+2 examples). Directly affects interior space utilization, passenger comfort and vehicle packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize a true 4-seat coupe layout while preserving a sleek coupé silhouette and sporty proportions.

parameters.parameter: Seating and cockpit dimensions; Cockpit tightness & seat lowering
parameters.range: 5th–95th percentile anthropometrics; may include reduced lateral and vertical clearances to achieve a low center-of-gravity feel
parameters.description: Parameters covering seat cushion heights, cushion depth, backrest angles, pedal and steering-wheel positions, instrument panel offset, driver seating height and cockpit lateral envelope. Includes cockpit tightness and seat lowering considerations to enhance sportiness, lower center of gravity and reduce weight.

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize low seating position, narrow cockpit envelope, minimal non-essential volume and integration of controls to reduce weight and enhance driver focus.

parameters.range: shallow - deep (例如 50mm - 250mm)
parameters.description: 车侧门槛和门腔深度，影响门的铰链布置与开合干涉。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在车身侧裙与门槛区域保留足够的结构深度以容纳上抬门铰链与门体收纳，优化门槛高度和门口开度以保证进出。

parameters.range: long wheelbase / short overhangs

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 设定侧面比例（较长的轴距/短前后悬）、低重心视觉、前后轮鼓突出以获得动感姿态。

parameters.parameter: Side profile slope; SideLinePitch; SideLineSlope (侧面坡度；侧线倾角；侧线前后高度差)
parameters.range: numeric: -5 to +8 degrees (sources report -5…+5 and 0…8); qualitative: front higher / flat / front lower
parameters.unit: degrees (数值角度); visual relation (视觉高度关系：front higher/flat/front lower)
parameters.description: 衡量车辆侧面腰线/肩线从车头到车尾的纵向抬升或俯仰角度。正值表示尾部上扬，可用角度（度）定量表示，也常用“前高/持平/前低”进行视觉描述。用于体现楔形家族特征及侧面动态。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 将侧线俯仰角调整为平直或在后段小幅正角（+1°~+3°），以产生新动态的尾部上扬感。

parameters.range: low (relative to touring tires)
parameters.description: Vertical height of the tire sidewall; lower values increase lateral stiffness and change visual stance.

guidance.howToGuide: Minimize sidewall height to improve lateral stiffness and visual low stance.

parameters.range: sized around 5th–99th percentile anthropometrics

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 以极端人口统计百分位（5th 到 99th）为基准来限定车内空间包线，确保整车尺寸最小化的同时满足人体工程学需求。

parameters.description: Lateral position of the wheel mounting face relative to wheel center; determines how far spokes sit inboard or outboard.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Requires wheel spoke profile and offset that provide clearance for rotor and caliper, pushing spokes outboard relative to wheel center.

parameters.range: 低 - 高（从柔和弧度到明显峰谷起伏）
parameters.unit: 曲率 / 相对高度比 / 描述性
parameters.description: 表示曲面整体的起伏幅度与局部曲率变化，影响视觉动感、光影变化以及局部气流行为。常以低/中/高幅度描述表面起伏程度。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 把海浪式的饱满曲面、波纹纹理与峰谷交错的线条转换为曲面起伏幅度、线条深度与连续性等设计参数。

parameters.description: 轮胎高度/轮胎宽度×100%，影响侧壁高度、离地高度与操控感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 降低胎高比（低扁平比），搭配更大直径轮圈以获得更运动的外观与更直接的操控感。

parameters.description: Velocidad punta objetivo del vehículo de producción.

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize parameters that reduce lap time: top speed, handling responsiveness, Cd reduction

parameters.description: Lateral distance between left and right wheel centers/contact patches at each axle. 影响车辆横向稳定性、横向荷载转移（per wheel）、外观车体姿态与轮位布局。受车架导轨、轮胎转向包络及发动机横向占用等工程约束影响。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Promote wider track and lower roof proportions to convey performance; balance with packaging and dynamic requirements.

parameters.range: none..multi-gear; common types: manual, automatic, dual-clutch, CVT; other/legacy forms: chain drive; example offered configurations: 2 manual + 1 three-speed automatic
parameters.description: Indicates whether a transmission is present and its type/complexity—ranging from no transmission to multi‑gear systems. Covers conventional categories (manual, automatic, dual-clutch, CVT), alternative drives (chain drive) and specific market/configuration offerings. Influences packaging, weight, efficiency and driving characteristics.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Provide multiple transmission configurations and trim options so buyers can tailor driving feel and economy.

parameters.range: Varies by vehicle type and era — generally from small up to very large; examples include effective small volumes for convertibles/battery‑packed vehicles and design targets >450 L for practical/utility-focused models. Historically trunk volumes increased (notably in 1950s–70s US cars).
parameters.unit: liters (L); can also be reported categorically (small/medium/large)
parameters.description: Volume of the rear luggage compartment. Relative increases compared with earlier compact rear‑sloped designs have occurred historically. Effective usable volume can be substantially reduced by convertible roof mechanisms, battery packaging, spare tire, or other packaging constraints. Some design targets specify volumes above 450 L to balance utility and styling.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过后备厢体积与开口设计保持载物能力，不牺牲Coupe线条的连续性。

parameters.range: continuous 0–1 (0 = raw chassis, 1 = fully smoothized); qualitative smooth–rough scale; includes configurations from partial local fairings to full flat tray with diffuser; contributes to minimized frontal area where applicable
parameters.unit: index (relative) / qualitative / m2 (when combined with frontal area)
parameters.description: 底盘底部表面平整度与整流器设计，影响总体阻力系数(Cd)、气流控制与底盘热管理；可用定性（smooth–rough）或相对量化指标(0–1)描述，亦常与减小正面投影面积一起考虑。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在设计参数层面优先设置下护板、底部平整度及尾部渐缩曲率以兼顾美感与空气学性能

parameters.range: 200-2500 kg（总体观测）；典型 600-1800 kg；设计目标：在符合包装与安全约束下尽量减小
parameters.description: 整车质量（整备质量/车重），影响加速、能耗、操控、气动、税制与分类。设计目标是在满足安全与包装约束下尽量减轻，用以指导材料与结构选择。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 以轻量化车架与铝合金车身为手段，严格控制整备质量以提升功重比与操控灵敏度。

parameters.description: 整车重量与最大功率之比，直接影响加速性能、操控与车辆姿态。

guidance.howToGuide: 将设计参数朝向更低的重量-功率比、紧凑舱室与后置动力总成包装进行优化；优先性能相关几何（如轮拱/轨距/低车身）。

parameters.range: 500-1200 mm; commonly larger than touring spec (e.g., +1 to +4 inches)
parameters.description: Diameter of road wheels; larger diameters improve roll over rough surfaces and were common on early vehicles. Specifications may be given in mm or inches.

guidance.howToGuide: Increase wheel diameter to allow larger brake rotors and to visually fill the wheel arch.

parameters.parameter: Wheel Diameter / 轮毂直径 / 轮圈直径
parameters.range: 16-22 inch (commonly 18-22 inch for rugged-family designs)
parameters.description: Wheel diameter affects wheel-arch visual proportion, vehicle lateral visual proportion and stance (dynamic vs. stable), and packaging of braking components. Larger wheels emphasize capability and visual presence, consistent with rugged design DNA.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): maximize wheel diameter within packaging (O.D.) and proportion constraints while selecting low aspect-ratio tires to achieve the desired sporty look

parameters.range: 典型范围 2500–3500 mm；常见 2700–3100 mm，按车型级别变化（短轴距→紧凑级；长轴距→中/大型）；示例值包括 2900–3000 mm、2980 mm、3480 mm
parameters.description: 前后车轮中心线之间的轴距。轴距影响后排腿部空间与车内容积、侧面视觉比例与伸展感、转弯半径/通过角以及车身直线稳定性。较长轴距常用于提升乘坐舒适性与豪华感与稳定性；较短轴距有利通过角与机动性。轴距长度也决定轮位与车门/悬长的视觉比例。

guidance.howToGuide: 通过延长轴距（如GST的2980 mm）以获得宽敞后排和更大行李厢容积，从而实现轿跑兼顾舒适性的目标

parameters.range: 依车型与级别不同：短轴距约2000–2500 mm；紧凑/城市车型常见约2400–2700 mm；MPV/大型车常见约2600–3100 mm；总体观测范围约2000–3200 mm；示例值：2800 mm
parameters.description: 前后车轴中心之间的纵向间距，决定乘员舱长度、车门尺寸与侧面比例；轴距增长通常带来更佳的乘坐舒适性和更大的内部空间，但会影响转弯半径与车身动态特性。轴距设计需和悬挂布局、前/后悬、平台一致性及家族设计语言共同考虑。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Maintain a wheelbase proportion that supports a coupe-like elongated silhouette and balanced overhangs to achieve a performance GT appearance.

parameters.parameter: Windshield Rake Angle / Windscreen Rake Angle (挡风/风挡倾角)
parameters.range: Typical values from vertical: ~10–40° (commonly 10–35°; many sources use 10–45° as an upper practical bound). When reported from horizontal (alternate convention, WA) typical values ≈50–75° (e.g. baseline example 64° from horizontal ≈ 26° from vertical). Broad absolute bounds in datasets can span ~0–90° but practical/packaging limits are much narrower.
parameters.description: Inclination (rake) of the windshield/windscreen relative to vertical (most commonly reported) — a primary packaging and exterior-design parameter that influences aerodynamic drag (Cd), forward visibility and vertical field-of-view, greenhouse proportions, interior headroom, driver sightlines, reflection geometry and veiling glare, and overall vehicle styling.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Increase windshield rake angle to achieve a low-slung silhouette and smoother airflow over the bonnet; prioritize visual continuity and reduced frontal pressure.

parameters.range: 相对轴距后移 40%~48%（距前轴）

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过缩短轴距相对车长、降低前端高度并将座舱后置来实现中置发动机跑车的视觉平衡与动感。

parameters.range: 0-10 deg
parameters.description: 车头相对于车尾的纵向高度差所对应的角度，影响视觉楔形感、俯冲视觉效果以及车辆整体气动特性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提高车尾高度、加大前后轴间的纵向高度差、调节风挡与后窗的相对角度
保持低矮前机舱高度并使用平滑过渡的弧线，使前端视觉重心降低，强化运动姿态。

parameters.range: 综合观测：80–350 mm；典型城市/轿车约100–220 mm；越野/SUV/皮卡常见180–350 mm；文档中亦出现180–320 mm、90–220 mm等区间及示例增量（+15 mm）。
parameters.description: 车辆最低点（底盘或轮拱底部）到地面的垂直距离。该参数直接影响通过性与越野能力、空气动力学（风阻与升力）、视觉姿态、底盘保护、重心分布与驾驶感受，是车身定位、护板高度与气动目标之间的重要设计权衡项。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Keep ground clearance moderate-to-low to preserve a low-slung visual stance while retaining practical usability.

parameters.parameter: 水平方向线条朝向; horizontal_line_convergence_angle
parameters.range: 向前汇聚（converging forward）/ 平行 / 向后；可细化为角度范围（small_forward_angle ≈ 0–5°）
parameters.description: 描述汽车造型中水平方向线条的汇聚趋势，可用定性分类（向前汇聚/平行/向后）表示，也可用汇聚角度定量描述（如小向前角约 0–5°）。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 布置平向线条略有向前收敛的倾角，形成视觉上的前向汇聚与动感。

parameters.range: deep red → orangish-red

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize deep red hue selection for perceived sportiness, while defining an allowable shift toward orangish-red to maintain legibility for color-deficient users.

parameters.range: noseTaperAngle: 3-12 deg; bonnetLength: high proportion of overall length
parameters.description: Geometric variables controlling how sharply the nose tapers and how long the bonnet extends relative to body.

guidance.howToGuide: Drive geometric settings that reduce hood taper angle, increase bonnet length and lower roofline to create the elongated profile.

parameters.range: ≈ -2° (前高后低) 到 +3° (尾部上扬)
parameters.description: 侧视轮廓的抬头或降低角度直接影响车辆整体姿态的动态感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将侧线坡度控制在近水平或在尾部引入1~3度上扬以实现新动态感。

parameters.range: jounce (compression) 0 — design jounce max (e.g., 0–60 mm typical; project-specific); typical total travel by vehicle class: sports 75–90 mm; passenger 100–120 mm; trucks/SUVs 125–150+ mm
parameters.description: Vertical wheel travel parameter covering both compression (jounce) and rebound. The jounce sub-parameter commonly references compression envelope sections (0 to design jounce max). Total travel values vary by vehicle class.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Limit suspension travel (75-90mm) to minimize visible openings and maintain tight wheel-to-body geometry.

parameters.parameter: wheelbase / front overhang / rear overhang / track width / wheel diameter / wheelbase-overhang ratio (轴距/前后悬/轮距/车轮直径/轴距/悬长比)
parameters.range: wheelDiameter: 17-22 inch; trackWidth: 1500-1650 mm; front overhang: 700-900 mm; rear overhang: 700-950 mm; wheelbase/overhang ratio: 长轴距短悬 ~ 标准比例（轴距长短及前后悬占比可变）
parameters.description: 聚合的车辆几何参数：轴距、前/后悬、轮距与车轮直径。轴距与悬长比例（wheelbase/overhang ratio）直接影响侧面伸展感与动态比例；轮距决定姿态与横向稳定性；车轮直径影响视觉比例与操控感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过增大轮径、加宽前后轮距与缩短前后悬来实现更运动的比例与视觉重心。

parameters.range: 延长/缩短、角度变化若干度
parameters.description: 控制侧窗视觉延伸与车顶下降的角度，直接决定溜背感与轿跑化程度。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 延长侧窗曲线、降低后车顶高度与增加尾部回缩角以形成溜背轮廓；调整车顶下降角和C柱位置。

parameters.description: 轴距分配决定车头/车尾视觉重心的位置。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 限定轴距与前/后悬的比例向短前悬、长后悬倾斜，以形成向前冲的视觉动势。
guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 在比例层面先行定义以确保后续造型保持一致的动感基调。

parameters.range: 高（明显收窄）

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 要求减小前端迎风截面并采用渐变截面以改善压力分布，兼顾视觉的尖锐感与气动效率。

parameters.range: 短至中等

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 定义后端截断（truncation）尺寸以在保持低阻的同时抑制升力，平衡基压与尾流结构。

parameters.range: -2° ~ +6°（示意范围，需模型/仿真验证）
parameters.description: 尾部相对于车身基准面的倾斜角，影响尾部的视觉高度、运动感以及局部气动特征。对整车造型与后部气流附着有影响，需通过模型或仿真确认对乘坐舒适性与气动阻力的影响。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 要求增大尾部上扬角度与降低车顶后段高度，以获得更强的视觉前低后高/上扬感

parameters.parameter: 引擎盖厚度（相对轮眉高度）
parameters.range: 偏大以满足越野行程与力量感

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先减小引擎盖厚度/轮眉落差，使引擎盖与轮眉接近平齐以强化低矮运动感。

parameters.range: 见上
parameters.description: 车身到地面的垂直距离，会直接影响视觉低重心与动感感知。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过降低整车离地高度、拉伸后悬及制造前低后倾的方向性姿态来增强视觉动感

parameters.description: 棱线深度是从面板表面到折线槽底的垂直距离（即折线相对于相邻面之间的高度差），决定阴影、光影对比和立体感的强弱。

guidance.howToGuide: 通过增加棱线深度、减小棱线边缘半径并延伸线迹至侧面来调节光影与阴影，从而塑造更强的体量感。

parameters.parameter: 线条/特征线位置与曲率 (Line/feature line position & curvature)
parameters.range: 从低平到高挑；从紧弯（小半径）到柔和大半径（大半径）
parameters.unit: mm / 曲率半径 / 相对曲率
parameters.description: 控制车身特征线或装饰线条的高度位置与弯曲程度，用以调节光影效果、视觉力量感与线条节奏。适用于一般线条与局部特征线，既可量化（半径/弯曲度）也可以视觉等级描述。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过规定腰线位置、关键折线的起止点与曲率，来塑造视觉上的肌肉感与前冲感

parameters.parameter: 线条方向 / 线条动感倾斜角度 / 速度 / 强度
parameters.range: 方向与倾斜角度：0-360°；强度：弱-强（分级）；速度感：主观量度（可用低/中/高或数值评分）
parameters.unit: °（角度） / 级别（强度） / 主观量表（速度感）
parameters.description: 描述线条的朝向与倾斜角度、视觉速度感及笔触强弱，影响动感表现。方向与倾斜以角度表示（0-360°），强度为分级量，速度感为主观评价，可通过等级或数值评分进行量化。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过线条倾斜、轮拱比例、车身低重心表征等参数来表达动感，同时用对称与均衡来维持稳定感。

parameters.parameter: 车肩宽度 / Shoulder breadth (双肩宽)
parameters.range: 310-475 mm（基于不同人群的5th–95th汇总）；相对趋势：跑车 > 轿跑 > 家用轿车
parameters.description: 作为区分车型家族与定位的核心设计参数，受家族设计语言指引。

guidance.howToGuide: 增大车肩宽度与侧门进深，以形成更强的横向体量感与肌肉曲面；适当压低温室占比以营造运动比例。

parameters.range: 从低矮运动型到高坐姿越野型；可用低—中—高定量描述，也可用前低后高、低重心或高腰线等定性形式表示
parameters.unit: mm（轮廓/离地高度） / 相对高度或视觉感知（相对比例）
parameters.description: 车辆给人的整体站姿感或视觉高度，受车身高度、轮廓高度（轮圈/轮胎与车身间距）、轮距、轴距、悬挂高度与车身比例共同影响。包括可测量的轮廓高度（mm）与基于视觉的相对姿态评价。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 通过降低整车重心、增宽前后轮距、调整前悬/后悬比例和拉长前机舱来呈现低矮、前倾与宽阔的视觉姿态；同时强化轮拱与肩部体块以传达力量感。

parameters.parameter: 车身比例/比值（如长/宽/高比、车身高度/宽度比、车身高/长比、轮距/车高比、姿态比例等）
parameters.range: 按车型定位调整的相对比值（示例：车身高度/宽度比 0.40-0.55；高/长比 可偏高以换取更大内部空间；姿态范围 低趴—中性—高重心）；轴距/悬长等亦为可调配比
parameters.description: 总体涵盖车身各部分的相对比例与比值，包括长/宽/高的相对关系、轮距/车高比、车身高度/宽度比与高/长比等。用于决定车辆整体姿态、内部空间表现及保持家族DNA与品牌识别的一致性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过拉长前引擎盖、缩短后悬、提高腰线与前低后高的比例来强化前冲与动势感。

parameters.range: 轻微上扬到明显上扬（0.5°–5°视车型）
parameters.description: 腰线的倾斜角与曲率影响车身的流动感与速度感。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 通过腰线坡度与上扬幅度定义速度感，明确腰线起止点与倾斜角度以形成向后延伸的视觉流动。
guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 指定腰线在车头至车尾的斜度与上扬节奏，以产生加速感与动态视觉。

parameters.range: 见上
parameters.description: 见上

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将车身质量分布与重心位置设计在前后轮之间并适当前移以营造前冲态势

recalled_nodes.name: 追求运动感、速度与个性

paths.path: 追求运动感、速度与个性 -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 运动
paths.reason: 该用户趋势明确诉求“运动感、速度与个性”，会促使设计在姿态与比例层面朝低矮宽阔的站姿、长机舱/短后悬、较大轮毂与更深的棱线与锐利表面细节等方向强化视觉动感；Rubric 中的 Stance/车身姿态、Power-to-weight ratio(功重比)、Hood/Bonnet length(引擎盖长度)、棱线深度(crease depth)等参数将这些几何与细节改动与运动风格的感知与实现直接关联，因而该特征被有意识强化时能稳定地强化运动风格感知。

paths.path: 追求运动感、速度与个性 -> TypeAssociatedWith -> 跑车
paths.reason: 该趋势直接指向以速度与运动性能为核心的车辆用途与姿态，约束到以低矮车身、性能化调校和速度体验为本质的跑车，与图谱中跑车的“运动”定位一致。

parameters.description: Target 0-100 km/h acceleration time

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize power-to-weight improvements, wide track, short 0-100s via drivetrain spec and weight reduction

parameters.description: Target acceleration emphasizing performance image.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Maximize low-end torque, minimize mass (power-to-weight), and use transmission tuning to meet 0-60 targets.

parameters.range: short — very long (relative proportion to wheelbase); often long when proportionally extended relative to the passenger compartment.
parameters.description: Length of the vehicle bonnet / front overhang. Contributes to an elongated, pointed silhouette and relates to the vehicle's proportions.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Definir proporciones con capó largo, frente bajo y ángulo de rampa pronunciado para acentuar la cuña.

parameters.description: Peak output target that defines performance character; affects packaging, cooling and perceived aggressiveness.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Set BHP targets as a primary design objective, optimize engine breathing and weight to achieve high peak power rather than just large displacement.

parameters.parameter: C点位置（相对车长的位置）
parameters.range: 靠前/居中/靠后（以车身纵向百分比或绝对距离表示）
parameters.description: C点位置影响视觉重心与前后尾部力量感的传达。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将C点向前布置以前移视觉重心，使引擎盖俯冲度增加，拉长前部线条并增强运动感。

parameters.range: Typical static camber angle ≈ -5° to +5° (vehicle dependent). Camber change under load typically ≈ ±1.5° (vehicle dependent). Change through travel can vary from <1° up to several degrees depending on arm length and geometry; camber curve/gain is tunable and often expressed per mm of travel or per degree of roll.
parameters.description: Camber angle is the angle between the wheel plane and the vertical (positive when the top of the wheel leans outwards). Camber change describes the variation of that angle through suspension travel, under load or during body roll; it is critical to maintaining the tire contact patch and tuning handling. Camber gain/loss can be controlled via suspension geometry and tuning.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify negative camber at cornering that increases with jounce; prioritize geometry that yields predictable camber gain under load.

parameters.description: Curb/vehicle weight (mass of vehicle without occupants or cargo). Source records reference a broad set of values reflecting different vehicles, eras, or measurement/reporting differences. Representative reported examples: ~520 kg (≈500–550 kg), 615 kg, ≈635 kg, 970–1160 kg. One record contains 6000 kg which is likely erroneous.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过减轻车体质量、优化包装与尺寸来直接控制车辆重量，从而提升动力性和外观的运动感。

parameters.range: short — long
parameters.description: Distance from the dashboard/base of the windshield (dash) to the front axle. Used by family DNA to enforce brand-typical proportions (e.g., long dash-to-axle for luxury lineage); extended values create a long-hood/long-stance appearance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Increase dash-to-axle to create a long-hood proportion typical of front-longitudinal-engine RWD sports cars; prioritize visual emphasis on hood length and forward mass.

parameters.range: sliding / scissor / gull-wing / rear-lift / vertical pivot / conventional swing
parameters.description: Selection of door types, hinge configurations and opening kinematics to balance packaging, accessibility and parking envelope. Determines how the door moves relative to the body (upward lift vs lateral swing) and impacts aperture requirements and vehicle packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将门铰链类型与开启弧线设定为向上/近垂直的抬起机构（scissor/vertical pivot），以避免横向外摆所需的侧向空间。

parameters.range: RWD
parameters.description: Rear-wheel drive selected to match front-longitudinal engine layout and performance handling goals.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor rear-wheel drive to reinforce dynamic handling and traditional sports-car character.

parameters.range: RWD primary; AWD optional (AWD achievable via transfer case added ahead of prop shaft)
parameters.description: Longitudinal engine → transmission → prop-shaft → offset fixed rear differential. Primary configuration is RWD; AWD can be provided by adding a transfer case ahead of the prop shaft.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Favor rear-wheel-drive as primary expression for lightness and driver engagement; allow AWD as an alternative to manage higher power outputs while preserving rear-biased dynamics.

parameters.range: varies (short — long)
parameters.description: Axial/longitudinal length occupied by the engine in the vehicle. Depends on cylinder count and arrangement and directly affects engine bay depth and overall vehicle longitudinal packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 允许并鼓励采用较长或更大尺寸的发动机布局，以满足功率与散热需求，优先动力性而非最小化体积。

parameters.parameter: Engine Location / 发动机位置 / 布置
parameters.range: 前置 / 前中 / 中置 / 中后 / 后置（纵向位置）
parameters.description: 动力装置（内燃机或电机组）相对于车轴与乘舱的纵向布置。常见取值为前置、前中、中置、中后、后置。布置会限制悬架与器件包装，影响驱动牵引、载荷姿态与乘舱长度；历史上布置有从后置向前置的演变。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Adopt longitudinal/front-mid or rear-biased engine placement to shape bonnet length and cabin setback for performance proportions.

parameters.parameter: engine_longitudinal_position; Engine Longitudinal Position (front / mid / rear / underfloor)
parameters.description: 发动机在纵向上的安装位置，相对于前轴的距离，影响配重、转向和内饰包装。Can be represented either as a continuous longitudinal offset (numeric, mm relative to front axle center) or as a categorical location (front / mid / rear / underfloor).

guidance.howToGuide: 优先采用中置或后置纵置布局以集中质量、减小转动惯量并优化瞬态响应

parameters.range: 常见布局包括 front-longitudinal、rear-mid（及其它布局）
parameters.description: 发动机安装位置与朝向（例如前纵置用于长前机舱比例；中置/后置影响操控与姿态）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify front-mounted longitudinal engine packaging to support RWD layout and the long dash-to-axle proportion.

parameters.range: 典型取值宽广，约 50–1000 hp（文献中亦见 0–600 CV）；示例值：113 CV @6500 rpm、345 CV、474 CV、480–550 hp
parameters.description: 发动机输出功率，直接影响加速、最高速与车辆的性能感知。值随车辆类型与时代差异很大，应以具体车型目标为准。

guidance.howToGuide: Drive selection of high peak power, aggressive gearing, weight reduction and minimal driver aids to achieve competition-grade performance.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify engine displacement and packaging to align with a performance/luxury character (mid-large displacement, performance tuning).

parameters.range: examples: 1,327 cc; 1,497 cc; 2,936 cc; 3,528 cc; 4,600 cc (various configurations and model examples)
parameters.description: Total swept volume of all cylinders; influences packaging, hood/engine-bay length, weight and external proportions, and correlates with power and character. Specifies available engine sizes that balance economy and sportiness. Examples in sources include small-displacement units (~1.3–1.5 L) up to multi-litre engines (e.g., 3.5–4.6 L); associated power examples noted (e.g., V6 305 CV; V8 5.0 412 CV).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先配置大排量V8发动机作为首要设计参数，以确保强烈的动力感与直观性能属性。

parameters.range: 常见/记录范围：~594–748 cc（小型/轻型车，如轻型车级别）；1,327–1,998 cc（中小级别示例）；2,000–4,000 cc（较大发动机）。记录的极端值可达 50,000 cc（文献/档案中记载，属异常值）。
parameters.unit: cc (等同于 mL); 有时与功率相关表述为 cc / kW
parameters.description: 发动机排量（engine capacity）直接影响输出功率与车辆性能。不同车辆类别对应不同排量：轻型车/微型车集中在数百 cc，常见乘用车在 ~1,300–2,000 cc，较大/商用车可达数千 cc。混合动力或增程/复合动力系统通常可采用减小的发动机排量（典型减幅约 −20% 至 −50% 或按等效功率计）。50,000 cc 为文献中记录的极端值，应视为例外/特殊情况。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 倾向于更大排量、更多缸数与更高功率，同时引入改良制动与机械控制以满足赛用需求。

parameters.description: Actual visible outer wheel diameter (flange) as referenced in wheel appearance tables (e.g., 16 in rim → ~440 mm flange).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Use the rim-inch to flange-mm mapping and choose flange diameter to achieve the target visible wheel proportion; increase flange relative to rim to emphasize wheel presence (typical rim -> flange difference 30–35 mm).

parameters.parameter: Front overhang (front wheel centre to front extremity)
parameters.range: Design targets favor as short as feasible; typical reference ranges vary (commonly ~300–600 mm; some sources list up to ~600–1200 mm) depending on vehicle class and packaging
parameters.description: Distance from front wheel centre to the foremost bodywork. Affects front visual proportion, hood/bonnet slope, approach angle, crash packaging, airflow initiation and cabin set-back/interior packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 建议增加前悬长度与降低前端视觉高度，以将车身重心视觉上向前推，形成向前俯冲的姿态。

parameters.description: 车窗面积相对于车身侧面整体的占比，影响视觉重心、运动感、豪华感以及驾驶视野与安全感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 采用较低的车窗/车身比例（约30%~40%玻璃）以降低视觉重心、强化低矮运动姿态。

parameters.parameter: Ground Clearance (离地间隙) & Ramp Over Angle
parameters.range: Ground clearance: 100-300 mm; Ramp over angle: not specified (degrees)
parameters.description: Ground clearance: vertical distance between the lowest vehicle part and the ground, typically 100–300 mm; constrained by underbody airflow management and other aerodynamic requirements. Ramp over angle: geometric angle describing the vehicle's ability to pass over ramps/obstacles, expressed in degrees; specific range not provided. / 离地间隙：车辆最低部位与地面之间的垂直距离，通常为100–300 mm，受底部气流管理等气动需求约束。Ramp over angle：描述车辆跨越坡道/障碍能力的几何角，以度为单位，未给出具体范围。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提高离地间隙、增大轮拱和提升接近/离去角以强化越野通过性与力量感。

parameters.range: Defined per vehicle class; typical vertical values approximately 300–950 mm overall. Common passenger car vertical ranges ~300–520 mm; seat-specific/target percentile ranges often 350–540 mm; some references use approx. 300–600 mm depending on measurement convention.
parameters.description: Geometric seating reference (seat pivot/hip point) used to define occupant seating position for seat mounting, interior packaging, safety and ergonomics. Affects ingress/egress, visibility and perceived interior roominess. Typically specified relative to the vehicle floor and a reference datum.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将驾驶员H点设低以降低重心并减少迎风面积，从而降低风阻并提升操控响应，代价是进出车门不便。

parameters.range: High responsiveness, reduced body roll

guidance.howToGuide: Optimize mass distribution, suspension kinematics and track width for responsiveness

parameters.range: low-slung, reclined seating; forward-set cabin

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Define seating height, recline and cockpit packaging to produce a deep-set, driver-focused posture consistent across models.

parameters.range: qualitative: large → stable/flat rake; small → sporty/steep rake

guidance.howToGuide: Reduce the wheel-arch-to-hood distance (smaller φ) to create a steeper front rake, lower visual center and sportier appearance.

parameters.description: 下部进气宽度与上部进气宽度的比例或差值，较大值带来更强运动感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先扩大下部进气宽度、增大前脸投影面积和下部开口以强调运动姿态。

parameters.range: steel; aluminum; engineering plastics (ABS, SMC, RIM); fiberglass; carbon-fiber composites; ceramics; other composites; veneers, leathers and coated plastics (low- to high-grade)
parameters.description: Selection of primary body, trim and component materials across interior and exterior (metals, plastics, composites, ceramics, veneers, leathers). Affects appearance, surface texture, weight, structural performance, perceived solidity/value, manufacturability and production processes.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先采用低密度高强度材料、优化部件几何以降低质量并兼顾散热与空气流通。

parameters.range: Varies by vehicle class and era. Documented/claimed values in the set span from single digits up to ~175 km/h. Representative examples: 4; 16; 25; up to 40; 100; 100–150; 150; 152–175; suggested design ranges e.g. 100–200 km/h.
parameters.description: Design target or documented maximum vehicle speed. Influenced by engine power, gearing, aerodynamics and intended use (urban/regional/performance). Values differ by historical era, variant and target use — e.g. historical vehicles show very low absolute speeds, performance models target higher speeds, and urban/regional vehicles target modest maxima to balance drag and efficiency.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize peak power, high-speed gearing and reduced aerodynamic drag to achieve target top speed.

parameters.description: Number of selectable gear ratios (historic 2–3 on some US cars, 4–5 on modern units).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): provide more gear ratios and manual control mechanisms to allow finer engine speed control and active driver involvement

parameters.range: conceptual; examples include layout choices such as Front‑engine / RWD / 2‑seat; supports modular package options
parameters.description: Allocation and organization of interior volumes, seat tracks, cargo zones and service channels, and the space reserved for powertrain; defines overall spatial allocation and modular package choices (e.g., interior volume vs. cargo vs. powertrain).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize two-seat cockpit, front‑engine longitudinal layout, rear‑wheel drive and lightweight construction to express domestic sports identity.

parameters.range: Reported values vary by vehicle and context. Examples and reported values include single-rated figures (e.g., 93 CV), example ranges such as 57 CV (Prius) to 262 CV (Model 3), high-performance variants ~1001–1200 CV (Veyron), and historical low examples like 48 hp (@1250 rpm).
parameters.description: Maximum engine power output (peak power). Values are reported in different units (CV or hp) and differ by vehicle, trim or measurement methodology; dataset shows both single rated values and broad example ranges.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Priorizar parámetros de potencia y transmisión (alta potencia máxima y relaciones cortas/largas combinadas) y optimizar Cd para alcanzar velocidad de punta.

parameters.description: RPM band where maximum horsepower is produced; moved higher for vehicles emphasizing speed and handling.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Shift power curve upward in RPM band (higher peak HP), prioritize lighter weight, higher-revving engines and chassis tuning for handling.

parameters.range: context-dependent; higher is better for performance (examples: 95 CV / 544 kg ≈ 0.175 CV/kg; 182 CV / ~620 kg ≈ 0.29 CV/kg). High example: >250 hp/ton
parameters.description: Power output per unit mass — key indicator of acceleration and dynamic performance. 表示单位质量的动力输出，是衡量车辆加速与性能的关键参数。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过提升发动机输出、减轻车重并优化传动比来提升动力响应与最高速

parameters.range: high/medium/low
parameters.description: Volume allocated for engine, transmission and drivetrain.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Allocate packaging volume and architecture to accommodate larger engines, mechanical transmissions and robust final drives; prioritize layouts that favor performance (e.g., longitudinal configurations).

parameters.range: model-dependent; per-unit low → high (examples: '↓ per unit', 'low', '<£10,000')
parameters.unit: currency (typ. reported per-unit in USD; GBP and other currencies possible)
parameters.description: 制造与装配整个产品的直接和间接成本总和，通常是价值工程的直接调节对象；决定组件/产品能否量产并广泛采用的关键因素。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Control styling and subsystem complexity to keep manufacturing and parts cost within low-budget target (<= £10,000).
prioritize a short front overhang, long hood and large wheel diameter to create a classic performance silhouette

parameters.parameter: Rear overhang / rear overhang length (distance from rear wheel centre/axle to rearmost body)
parameters.range: Depends on vehicle class and packaging: hatchbacks/compact ~200–450 mm; typical passenger cars often 600–900 mm; reported design ranges vary—overall 200–900 mm depending on layout and requirements
parameters.description: Length of vehicle body beyond the rear axle/wheel centre. Influences departure angle, rear packaging (cargo, spare/EV components), suspension and differential packaging, hatch geometry/angle, and overall rear proportions.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 削减后端突出的尾部体量，使尾部轮廓更紧凑以强化前倾感。

parameters.range: comfortable (>880 mm typical for premium sedans)
parameters.description: Fore–aft usable space for rear occupants; typical guidance for comfortable packaging is around or above 880 mm (≈34.6 in).

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在底盘和车身包装上权衡，延长乘员舱与适度加长后备厢深度以保持舒适性。

parameters.description: Engine maximum practical rpm and responsiveness; influences exhaust tuning and driver perception.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify high engine speed capability and lightweight rotating components to enable high-rpm power delivery as a styling cue for performance.

parameters.range: 典型名义值与可调范围随车用场景与悬架系统而异；常见数值范围约 80–320 mm（即 0.08–0.32 m），最小许可值常见于 90–160 mm；系统可提供 ±20–50 mm 的调节或按应用定义（application-dependent）；具体值依车辆级别与底盘架构而定
parameters.description: 定义车辆参考点（如簧顶或车身参考点）到地面的垂直距离，直接影响车身姿态、离地间隙、通过性、视觉高度、整车正负气动截面与下扰流、底盘包装与 NVH。也与车身在加速/制动/转向时的俯仰/侧倾/下沉/压缩（roll/dive/squat）控制能力相关。

guidance.howToGuide: 通过降低整车高度、拉长轴距、缩短前后悬、加宽轮距来实现低矮宽扁的超跑比例；同时强调低风阻断面。

parameters.parameter: Roofline Angle / Roof Slope Angle / roofline_angle / roofRakeAngle
parameters.description: Average rearward inclination of the roof from A-pillar toward the rear (roofline rake/slope). 影响车顶溜背感、后备箱空间、内部头部空间以及气动阻力和气流分离（steeper slopes can increase drag if they induce separation; controlled slope supports attached flow）。涵盖快背/溜背设计中常见的取值范围和语义（包括roof rake 表述）。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过降低车顶高度、增加前伸低鼻与后抬的车身倾角（roof rake），形成楔形侧廓；强调低风阻轮廓与锐利平面。

parameters.range: varies by segment; optimized between interior headroom and aerodynamic silhouette
parameters.description: Overall vertical envelope of the roof — 车顶最高点的垂直尺寸。决定内部头部空间与外观轮廓，对空气动力学目标和车内包装约束有直接影响。常以车身细分市场和设计意图为依据调整。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Lower roof height by a design delta (e.g., 40–120 mm vs a neutral variant) to reduce visual center of gravity and elongate silhouette.

parameters.range: Varies broadly (low–high); example typical values ~1200–1400 mm for lower sport-oriented designs
parameters.description: 车顶高度可从低到高变化；较低的车顶高度营造低矮姿态，强调运动/性能取向；具体数值随车型和目标定位而定。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 压低车顶线、延长引擎罩、缩短车尾与地面的视觉距离，增大轮胎/轮辋尺寸以增强动感。

parameters.range: 0–30° (典型约5–15°，对应gentle to moderate fastback)
parameters.description: 车顶后倾角度，直接影响气流分离和整车阻力系数。Roofline slope (rearward roof inclination) affects airflow separation and drag coefficient.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过调节车顶线条、轴距与后备厢长度，在视觉上实现低矮运动感同时保证后排乘坐空间与行李容积。

parameters.parameter: Seat height / Seating height / Hip point (cushion top or seating reference above floor/ground)
parameters.description: 座椅坐面顶端或坐姿参考点（臀部点/H30）相对于地面或车内地板的垂直位置；影响上下车便捷性、坐姿舒适性、视野（视点高度）及内饰布局。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Specify low seat mounting to reduce centre of gravity and convey sporting stance; accept reduced ingress/egress.

parameters.range: 175 mm (implemented compromise); anthropometric target: accommodate 5th–99th percentile; reported design ranges up to 300–500 mm
parameters.description: Available fore-aft travel of the seat after engineering/package compromises. Used to accommodate driver anthropometry (e.g., 5th–99th percentile); reported ranges vary depending on packaging and target user population.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先将设计参数限制在覆盖极端人群（5th–99th percentile）的可调范围内，以实现最小化车体体积同时保证驾驶者适配性。

parameters.range: 1-3; 2+2 (4 seats); 4+2 (GST example)
parameters.description: Seat arrangement and distribution (e.g., 2+2 coupe layout, 4+2 examples). Directly affects interior space utilization, passenger comfort and vehicle packaging.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize a true 4-seat coupe layout while preserving a sleek coupé silhouette and sporty proportions.

parameters.parameter: Seating and cockpit dimensions; Cockpit tightness & seat lowering
parameters.range: 5th–95th percentile anthropometrics; may include reduced lateral and vertical clearances to achieve a low center-of-gravity feel
parameters.description: Parameters covering seat cushion heights, cushion depth, backrest angles, pedal and steering-wheel positions, instrument panel offset, driver seating height and cockpit lateral envelope. Includes cockpit tightness and seat lowering considerations to enhance sportiness, lower center of gravity and reduce weight.

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize low seating position, narrow cockpit envelope, minimal non-essential volume and integration of controls to reduce weight and enhance driver focus.

parameters.range: shallow - deep (例如 50mm - 250mm)
parameters.description: 车侧门槛和门腔深度，影响门的铰链布置与开合干涉。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在车身侧裙与门槛区域保留足够的结构深度以容纳上抬门铰链与门体收纳，优化门槛高度和门口开度以保证进出。

parameters.range: long wheelbase / short overhangs

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 设定侧面比例（较长的轴距/短前后悬）、低重心视觉、前后轮鼓突出以获得动感姿态。

parameters.parameter: Side profile slope; SideLinePitch; SideLineSlope (侧面坡度；侧线倾角；侧线前后高度差)
parameters.range: numeric: -5 to +8 degrees (sources report -5…+5 and 0…8); qualitative: front higher / flat / front lower
parameters.unit: degrees (数值角度); visual relation (视觉高度关系：front higher/flat/front lower)
parameters.description: 衡量车辆侧面腰线/肩线从车头到车尾的纵向抬升或俯仰角度。正值表示尾部上扬，可用角度（度）定量表示，也常用“前高/持平/前低”进行视觉描述。用于体现楔形家族特征及侧面动态。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 将侧线俯仰角调整为平直或在后段小幅正角（+1°~+3°），以产生新动态的尾部上扬感。

parameters.range: low (relative to touring tires)
parameters.description: Vertical height of the tire sidewall; lower values increase lateral stiffness and change visual stance.

guidance.howToGuide: Minimize sidewall height to improve lateral stiffness and visual low stance.

parameters.range: sized around 5th–99th percentile anthropometrics

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 以极端人口统计百分位（5th 到 99th）为基准来限定车内空间包线，确保整车尺寸最小化的同时满足人体工程学需求。

parameters.description: Lateral position of the wheel mounting face relative to wheel center; determines how far spokes sit inboard or outboard.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Requires wheel spoke profile and offset that provide clearance for rotor and caliper, pushing spokes outboard relative to wheel center.

parameters.range: 低 - 高（从柔和弧度到明显峰谷起伏）
parameters.unit: 曲率 / 相对高度比 / 描述性
parameters.description: 表示曲面整体的起伏幅度与局部曲率变化，影响视觉动感、光影变化以及局部气流行为。常以低/中/高幅度描述表面起伏程度。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 把海浪式的饱满曲面、波纹纹理与峰谷交错的线条转换为曲面起伏幅度、线条深度与连续性等设计参数。

parameters.description: 轮胎高度/轮胎宽度×100%，影响侧壁高度、离地高度与操控感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 降低胎高比（低扁平比），搭配更大直径轮圈以获得更运动的外观与更直接的操控感。

parameters.description: Velocidad punta objetivo del vehículo de producción.

guidance.howToGuide: Prioritize parameters that reduce lap time: top speed, handling responsiveness, Cd reduction

parameters.description: Lateral distance between left and right wheel centers/contact patches at each axle. 影响车辆横向稳定性、横向荷载转移（per wheel）、外观车体姿态与轮位布局。受车架导轨、轮胎转向包络及发动机横向占用等工程约束影响。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Promote wider track and lower roof proportions to convey performance; balance with packaging and dynamic requirements.

parameters.range: none..multi-gear; common types: manual, automatic, dual-clutch, CVT; other/legacy forms: chain drive; example offered configurations: 2 manual + 1 three-speed automatic
parameters.description: Indicates whether a transmission is present and its type/complexity—ranging from no transmission to multi‑gear systems. Covers conventional categories (manual, automatic, dual-clutch, CVT), alternative drives (chain drive) and specific market/configuration offerings. Influences packaging, weight, efficiency and driving characteristics.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Provide multiple transmission configurations and trim options so buyers can tailor driving feel and economy.

parameters.range: Varies by vehicle type and era — generally from small up to very large; examples include effective small volumes for convertibles/battery‑packed vehicles and design targets >450 L for practical/utility-focused models. Historically trunk volumes increased (notably in 1950s–70s US cars).
parameters.unit: liters (L); can also be reported categorically (small/medium/large)
parameters.description: Volume of the rear luggage compartment. Relative increases compared with earlier compact rear‑sloped designs have occurred historically. Effective usable volume can be substantially reduced by convertible roof mechanisms, battery packaging, spare tire, or other packaging constraints. Some design targets specify volumes above 450 L to balance utility and styling.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过后备厢体积与开口设计保持载物能力，不牺牲Coupe线条的连续性。

parameters.range: continuous 0–1 (0 = raw chassis, 1 = fully smoothized); qualitative smooth–rough scale; includes configurations from partial local fairings to full flat tray with diffuser; contributes to minimized frontal area where applicable
parameters.unit: index (relative) / qualitative / m2 (when combined with frontal area)
parameters.description: 底盘底部表面平整度与整流器设计，影响总体阻力系数(Cd)、气流控制与底盘热管理；可用定性（smooth–rough）或相对量化指标(0–1)描述，亦常与减小正面投影面积一起考虑。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 在设计参数层面优先设置下护板、底部平整度及尾部渐缩曲率以兼顾美感与空气学性能

parameters.range: 200-2500 kg（总体观测）；典型 600-1800 kg；设计目标：在符合包装与安全约束下尽量减小
parameters.description: 整车质量（整备质量/车重），影响加速、能耗、操控、气动、税制与分类。设计目标是在满足安全与包装约束下尽量减轻，用以指导材料与结构选择。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 以轻量化车架与铝合金车身为手段，严格控制整备质量以提升功重比与操控灵敏度。

parameters.description: 整车重量与最大功率之比，直接影响加速性能、操控与车辆姿态。

guidance.howToGuide: 将设计参数朝向更低的重量-功率比、紧凑舱室与后置动力总成包装进行优化；优先性能相关几何（如轮拱/轨距/低车身）。

parameters.range: 500-1200 mm; commonly larger than touring spec (e.g., +1 to +4 inches)
parameters.description: Diameter of road wheels; larger diameters improve roll over rough surfaces and were common on early vehicles. Specifications may be given in mm or inches.

guidance.howToGuide: Increase wheel diameter to allow larger brake rotors and to visually fill the wheel arch.

parameters.parameter: Wheel Diameter / 轮毂直径 / 轮圈直径
parameters.range: 16-22 inch (commonly 18-22 inch for rugged-family designs)
parameters.description: Wheel diameter affects wheel-arch visual proportion, vehicle lateral visual proportion and stance (dynamic vs. stable), and packaging of braking components. Larger wheels emphasize capability and visual presence, consistent with rugged design DNA.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): maximize wheel diameter within packaging (O.D.) and proportion constraints while selecting low aspect-ratio tires to achieve the desired sporty look

parameters.range: 典型范围 2500–3500 mm；常见 2700–3100 mm，按车型级别变化（短轴距→紧凑级；长轴距→中/大型）；示例值包括 2900–3000 mm、2980 mm、3480 mm
parameters.description: 前后车轮中心线之间的轴距。轴距影响后排腿部空间与车内容积、侧面视觉比例与伸展感、转弯半径/通过角以及车身直线稳定性。较长轴距常用于提升乘坐舒适性与豪华感与稳定性；较短轴距有利通过角与机动性。轴距长度也决定轮位与车门/悬长的视觉比例。

guidance.howToGuide: 通过延长轴距（如GST的2980 mm）以获得宽敞后排和更大行李厢容积，从而实现轿跑兼顾舒适性的目标

parameters.range: 依车型与级别不同：短轴距约2000–2500 mm；紧凑/城市车型常见约2400–2700 mm；MPV/大型车常见约2600–3100 mm；总体观测范围约2000–3200 mm；示例值：2800 mm
parameters.description: 前后车轴中心之间的纵向间距，决定乘员舱长度、车门尺寸与侧面比例；轴距增长通常带来更佳的乘坐舒适性和更大的内部空间，但会影响转弯半径与车身动态特性。轴距设计需和悬挂布局、前/后悬、平台一致性及家族设计语言共同考虑。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Maintain a wheelbase proportion that supports a coupe-like elongated silhouette and balanced overhangs to achieve a performance GT appearance.

parameters.parameter: Windshield Rake Angle / Windscreen Rake Angle (挡风/风挡倾角)
parameters.range: Typical values from vertical: ~10–40° (commonly 10–35°; many sources use 10–45° as an upper practical bound). When reported from horizontal (alternate convention, WA) typical values ≈50–75° (e.g. baseline example 64° from horizontal ≈ 26° from vertical). Broad absolute bounds in datasets can span ~0–90° but practical/packaging limits are much narrower.
parameters.description: Inclination (rake) of the windshield/windscreen relative to vertical (most commonly reported) — a primary packaging and exterior-design parameter that influences aerodynamic drag (Cd), forward visibility and vertical field-of-view, greenhouse proportions, interior headroom, driver sightlines, reflection geometry and veiling glare, and overall vehicle styling.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Increase windshield rake angle to achieve a low-slung silhouette and smoother airflow over the bonnet; prioritize visual continuity and reduced frontal pressure.

parameters.range: 相对轴距后移 40%~48%（距前轴）

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过缩短轴距相对车长、降低前端高度并将座舱后置来实现中置发动机跑车的视觉平衡与动感。

parameters.range: 0-10 deg
parameters.description: 车头相对于车尾的纵向高度差所对应的角度，影响视觉楔形感、俯冲视觉效果以及车辆整体气动特性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 提高车尾高度、加大前后轴间的纵向高度差、调节风挡与后窗的相对角度
保持低矮前机舱高度并使用平滑过渡的弧线，使前端视觉重心降低，强化运动姿态。

parameters.range: 综合观测：80–350 mm；典型城市/轿车约100–220 mm；越野/SUV/皮卡常见180–350 mm；文档中亦出现180–320 mm、90–220 mm等区间及示例增量（+15 mm）。
parameters.description: 车辆最低点（底盘或轮拱底部）到地面的垂直距离。该参数直接影响通过性与越野能力、空气动力学（风阻与升力）、视觉姿态、底盘保护、重心分布与驾驶感受，是车身定位、护板高度与气动目标之间的重要设计权衡项。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Keep ground clearance moderate-to-low to preserve a low-slung visual stance while retaining practical usability.

parameters.parameter: 水平方向线条朝向; horizontal_line_convergence_angle
parameters.range: 向前汇聚（converging forward）/ 平行 / 向后；可细化为角度范围（small_forward_angle ≈ 0–5°）
parameters.description: 描述汽车造型中水平方向线条的汇聚趋势，可用定性分类（向前汇聚/平行/向后）表示，也可用汇聚角度定量描述（如小向前角约 0–5°）。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 布置平向线条略有向前收敛的倾角，形成视觉上的前向汇聚与动感。

parameters.range: deep red → orangish-red

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Prioritize deep red hue selection for perceived sportiness, while defining an allowable shift toward orangish-red to maintain legibility for color-deficient users.

parameters.range: noseTaperAngle: 3-12 deg; bonnetLength: high proportion of overall length
parameters.description: Geometric variables controlling how sharply the nose tapers and how long the bonnet extends relative to body.

guidance.howToGuide: Drive geometric settings that reduce hood taper angle, increase bonnet length and lower roofline to create the elongated profile.

parameters.range: ≈ -2° (前高后低) 到 +3° (尾部上扬)
parameters.description: 侧视轮廓的抬头或降低角度直接影响车辆整体姿态的动态感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将侧线坡度控制在近水平或在尾部引入1~3度上扬以实现新动态感。

parameters.range: jounce (compression) 0 — design jounce max (e.g., 0–60 mm typical; project-specific); typical total travel by vehicle class: sports 75–90 mm; passenger 100–120 mm; trucks/SUVs 125–150+ mm
parameters.description: Vertical wheel travel parameter covering both compression (jounce) and rebound. The jounce sub-parameter commonly references compression envelope sections (0 to design jounce max). Total travel values vary by vehicle class.

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): Limit suspension travel (75-90mm) to minimize visible openings and maintain tight wheel-to-body geometry.

parameters.parameter: wheelbase / front overhang / rear overhang / track width / wheel diameter / wheelbase-overhang ratio (轴距/前后悬/轮距/车轮直径/轴距/悬长比)
parameters.range: wheelDiameter: 17-22 inch; trackWidth: 1500-1650 mm; front overhang: 700-900 mm; rear overhang: 700-950 mm; wheelbase/overhang ratio: 长轴距短悬 ~ 标准比例（轴距长短及前后悬占比可变）
parameters.description: 聚合的车辆几何参数：轴距、前/后悬、轮距与车轮直径。轴距与悬长比例（wheelbase/overhang ratio）直接影响侧面伸展感与动态比例；轮距决定姿态与横向稳定性；车轮直径影响视觉比例与操控感。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过增大轮径、加宽前后轮距与缩短前后悬来实现更运动的比例与视觉重心。

parameters.range: 延长/缩短、角度变化若干度
parameters.description: 控制侧窗视觉延伸与车顶下降的角度，直接决定溜背感与轿跑化程度。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 延长侧窗曲线、降低后车顶高度与增加尾部回缩角以形成溜背轮廓；调整车顶下降角和C柱位置。

parameters.description: 轴距分配决定车头/车尾视觉重心的位置。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 限定轴距与前/后悬的比例向短前悬、长后悬倾斜，以形成向前冲的视觉动势。
guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 在比例层面先行定义以确保后续造型保持一致的动感基调。

parameters.range: 高（明显收窄）

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 要求减小前端迎风截面并采用渐变截面以改善压力分布，兼顾视觉的尖锐感与气动效率。

parameters.range: 短至中等

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 定义后端截断（truncation）尺寸以在保持低阻的同时抑制升力，平衡基压与尾流结构。

parameters.range: -2° ~ +6°（示意范围，需模型/仿真验证）
parameters.description: 尾部相对于车身基准面的倾斜角，影响尾部的视觉高度、运动感以及局部气动特征。对整车造型与后部气流附着有影响，需通过模型或仿真确认对乘坐舒适性与气动阻力的影响。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 要求增大尾部上扬角度与降低车顶后段高度，以获得更强的视觉前低后高/上扬感

parameters.parameter: 引擎盖厚度（相对轮眉高度）
parameters.range: 偏大以满足越野行程与力量感

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 优先减小引擎盖厚度/轮眉落差，使引擎盖与轮眉接近平齐以强化低矮运动感。

parameters.range: 见上
parameters.description: 车身到地面的垂直距离，会直接影响视觉低重心与动感感知。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过降低整车离地高度、拉伸后悬及制造前低后倾的方向性姿态来增强视觉动感

parameters.description: 棱线深度是从面板表面到折线槽底的垂直距离（即折线相对于相邻面之间的高度差），决定阴影、光影对比和立体感的强弱。

guidance.howToGuide: 通过增加棱线深度、减小棱线边缘半径并延伸线迹至侧面来调节光影与阴影，从而塑造更强的体量感。

parameters.parameter: 线条/特征线位置与曲率 (Line/feature line position & curvature)
parameters.range: 从低平到高挑；从紧弯（小半径）到柔和大半径（大半径）
parameters.unit: mm / 曲率半径 / 相对曲率
parameters.description: 控制车身特征线或装饰线条的高度位置与弯曲程度，用以调节光影效果、视觉力量感与线条节奏。适用于一般线条与局部特征线，既可量化（半径/弯曲度）也可以视觉等级描述。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过规定腰线位置、关键折线的起止点与曲率，来塑造视觉上的肌肉感与前冲感

parameters.parameter: 线条方向 / 线条动感倾斜角度 / 速度 / 强度
parameters.range: 方向与倾斜角度：0-360°；强度：弱-强（分级）；速度感：主观量度（可用低/中/高或数值评分）
parameters.unit: °（角度） / 级别（强度） / 主观量表（速度感）
parameters.description: 描述线条的朝向与倾斜角度、视觉速度感及笔触强弱，影响动感表现。方向与倾斜以角度表示（0-360°），强度为分级量，速度感为主观评价，可通过等级或数值评分进行量化。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过线条倾斜、轮拱比例、车身低重心表征等参数来表达动感，同时用对称与均衡来维持稳定感。

parameters.parameter: 车肩宽度 / Shoulder breadth (双肩宽)
parameters.range: 310-475 mm（基于不同人群的5th–95th汇总）；相对趋势：跑车 > 轿跑 > 家用轿车
parameters.description: 作为区分车型家族与定位的核心设计参数，受家族设计语言指引。

guidance.howToGuide: 增大车肩宽度与侧门进深，以形成更强的横向体量感与肌肉曲面；适当压低温室占比以营造运动比例。

parameters.range: 从低矮运动型到高坐姿越野型；可用低—中—高定量描述，也可用前低后高、低重心或高腰线等定性形式表示
parameters.unit: mm（轮廓/离地高度） / 相对高度或视觉感知（相对比例）
parameters.description: 车辆给人的整体站姿感或视觉高度，受车身高度、轮廓高度（轮圈/轮胎与车身间距）、轮距、轴距、悬挂高度与车身比例共同影响。包括可测量的轮廓高度（mm）与基于视觉的相对姿态评价。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 通过降低整车重心、增宽前后轮距、调整前悬/后悬比例和拉长前机舱来呈现低矮、前倾与宽阔的视觉姿态；同时强化轮拱与肩部体块以传达力量感。

parameters.parameter: 车身比例/比值（如长/宽/高比、车身高度/宽度比、车身高/长比、轮距/车高比、姿态比例等）
parameters.range: 按车型定位调整的相对比值（示例：车身高度/宽度比 0.40-0.55；高/长比 可偏高以换取更大内部空间；姿态范围 低趴—中性—高重心）；轴距/悬长等亦为可调配比
parameters.description: 总体涵盖车身各部分的相对比例与比值，包括长/宽/高的相对关系、轮距/车高比、车身高度/宽度比与高/长比等。用于决定车辆整体姿态、内部空间表现及保持家族DNA与品牌识别的一致性。

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 通过拉长前引擎盖、缩短后悬、提高腰线与前低后高的比例来强化前冲与动势感。

parameters.range: 轻微上扬到明显上扬（0.5°–5°视车型）
parameters.description: 腰线的倾斜角与曲率影响车身的流动感与速度感。

guidance.guidanceStrategy(指导策略): 通过腰线坡度与上扬幅度定义速度感，明确腰线起止点与倾斜角度以形成向后延伸的视觉流动。
guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 指定腰线在车头至车尾的斜度与上扬节奏，以产生加速感与动态视觉。

parameters.range: 见上
parameters.description: 见上

guidance.howToGuide(指导方式): 将车身质量分布与重心位置设计在前后轮之间并适当前移以营造前冲态势

style_type_level.cypher:
MATCH p=(n:汽车车型)-[:包含]-(v:汽车实例)-[:EXPRESSES_STYLE]-(style:`汽车风格`)
MATCH (l:汽车级别)-[:包含]->(v)
WHERE style.name CONTAINS '运动' AND n.name CONTAINS '跑车' AND l.name CONTAINS 'A级'

paths.reason: 此特征属细节层面（灯组几何与光学处理），根据 Rubric 中的 Lamp Geometry / Signature Elements，精细化灯组（像素化灯带、特征化光学轮廓、可编程光效）稳定地强化数字化与技术集成的视觉信号，从而持续传达科技风格。

paths.path: Preference for unique and high-tech details -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 该特征主要改变细节与交互层面；有意识强化“独特且高科技的细节”会稳定强化科技风格感知，因为它通过签名化灯光/图形、传感器可视化与集成、以及大屏/高响应交互等元素直接映射到Rubric中的Signature Elements、Sensor & actuator integration level、DisplayAreaSize/HMI_DisplaySize与HMI Responsiveness等参数，从而跨车型形成一致的数字化/科技识别。

paths.path: 突破同质化 / 追求差异化科技感 -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 该节点有意识强化“科技感与差异化”主要改变层面为交互、细节与表面（如更大/可重构显示、灯光签名、传感器可见性、表面简洁化与锐利度）；这些具体要素在 Rubric 中由 Signature Elements、DisplayAreaSize、Sensor & actuator integration level、surface_simplicity 等参数直接量化，持续强化这些参数会稳定传达并实现科技风格。

paths.path: 高端智能电动车审美偏好 -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 语义聚焦于“智能+电动车”，当有意识强化会在交互与表面层面表现为更大/更集成的显示（DisplayAreaSize/Infotainment/Central Screen Size）、更高的传感器与执行器可见性或隐藏集成（Sensor & actuator integration level）与更强的计算能力（Compute Power），并配合表面简洁度(surface_simplicity)形成稳定的科技感视觉语言。

paths.path: 未来感内饰氛围 -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 大尺寸显示与平面化布局直接对应 Rubric 中的 DisplayAreaSize / HMI_DisplaySize 与 surface_simplicity 参数，配合环境光与科技感材料会稳定传达数字化、交互与电子化优先的“科技”内饰定位。

paths.path: Luxury Tech Adopters -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 改变层面：交互与电子集成。定位为“高端/早期科技采用者”的用户趋势会稳定推动更大显示面积、更多算力与更高的传感器/执行器可见度与集成度（Rubric参数示例：DisplayAreaSize、Compute Power、Sensor & actuator integration level、Signature Elements），这些是可量化且跨车型一致地强化‘科技’风格的设计取向。

paths.path: 未来科技感姿态 / 极简未来直立姿态 (Futuristic Minimalist Tech Upright Stance) -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 贯穿光带、抽象化灯组与极简线面是数字化/未来化的稳定视觉信号，会强化“科技”感；对应 Rubric 中的 Lamp Geometry（灯组几何）、surface_simplicity（表面简洁度）、Signature Elements（识别性元素）与 Silhouette（轮廓/外形）参数，解释了为何该特征集合能跨车型稳定传达科技风格。

paths.path: smartized_configuration -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 该特征属于交互层面（人机交互/车载互联与ADAS配置），当有意强化会稳定传达“科技”风格。对应 Rubric 中的 Digitalization Level/ADAS、DisplayAreaSize、HMI_Responsiveness、Compute Power 与 Sensor integration packaging 等参数，均用于量化并识别科技感的设计表达。

paths.path: Tech-forward外观线条与细节 -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 该节点位于外观细节层面（灯组、封闭格栅、光带与可编程灯效），通过电子化灯光签名与表面简洁化强化前卫/数字化视觉识别；对应 Rubric 中的 Lamp Geometry、灯带长度/像素密度、Signature Elements 与 surface_simplicity 参数，故在不同车型间稳定传达并强化科技风格。

paths.path: Personalized Premium Futurism (个性化+溢价+未来感) -> StyleAssociatedWith -> 科技
paths.reason: 改变层面：交互、细节与表面。强化可配置的个性化选项与前瞻科技视觉语言会以可重构的大屏/界面、像素化灯组与标识性科技细节及简洁连续表面传达持续的‘科技’感；对应Rubric中的“Personalization Options”（可定制性）与“Signature Elements/表面简洁度（surface_simplicity）”说明这类特征稳定支持科技风格。
